new_roles.title: Senior Plant Manager - Peach Tree City, GA
new_roles.description:
**WHY DO WE NEED YOU?**

The Senior Plant Manager is responsible for the safe, efficient, and profitable operation of our CertainTeed Roofing manufacturing facility in Peachtree City. Reporting to the Senior Director of Regional Operations, this role provides overall leadership for safety, quality, production, cost, delivery, people development, and sustainability performance.

You will set the vision and culture for the site, align daily operations with business strategy, and lead continuous improvement and long term plant performance. Success in this role requires sound judgment, strong business and people leadership, and the ability to balance workforce engagement, customer expectations, regulatory compliance, and community responsibility.

 **IS THIS JOB FOR YOU?**

**What you will do:**

* Lead all aspects of plant operations, including safety, production, maintenance, quality, logistics, engineering, and environmental performance.
* Build and sustain a strong safety culture where health and safety are integrated into daily decisions and operations.
* Deliver plant performance goals across safety, quality, service, cost, productivity, and profitability.
* Own the plant operating budget, forecasting, cost management, and long range planning.
* Drive continuous improvement through Lean Manufacturing, reliability, process optimization, problem solving, and operational excellence.
* Lead change initiatives and translate business strategy into actionable plant priorities and measurable results.
* Build and develop a high performing leadership team through coaching, feedback, succession planning, and employee development.
* Partner cross functionally with Sales, Supply Chain, R&D, Product Management, and other key stakeholders to support customer and business needs.
* Provide leadership for major capital projects and other strategic plant initiatives.

**What you bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent experience, required.
* 10+ years of progressive production or operations management experience.
* 5 to 7 years of experience at the Production Manager or Plant Superintendent level preferred.
* Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, or Operations Management preferred.
* Strong knowledge of production planning, scheduling, supply chain, budgeting, forecasting, and cost control.
* Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, WCM, or similar continuous improvement methodologies.
* Knowledge of quality management systems, equipment reliability, process optimization, OSHA requirements, and safety practices.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem solving, and change management skills.
* Ability to travel domestically approximately 20% of the time.

 
**A LITTLE MORE ABOUT US**

Through the responsible development of innovative and sustainable building products, CertainTeed, headquartered in Malvern, Pennsylvania, has helped shape the building products industry for more than 110 years. Founded in 1904 as General Roofing Manufacturing Company, the company’s slogan, “Quality Made Certain, Satisfaction Guaranteed,” inspired the name CertainTeed. Today, CertainTeed is a leading North American brand of exterior and interior building products, including roofing, siding, trim, insulation, drywall, and ceilings. CertainTeed is a subsidiary of Saint-Gobain, one of the world’s largest and oldest building products companies.

 **LEGAL STATEMENT**

Saint-Gobain provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. Saint-Gobain is an equal opportunity employer of individuals with disabilities and supports the hiring of veterans.

Applicants for roles based in Washington state or remote roles that would be worked from Washington state are encouraged to direct any concerns regarding the state’s Pay Transparency laws to the SGNA HR Compliance team at SGNA\_HR\_Compliance@saint-gobain.com.

 **BENEFITS IN JOINING US**

Saint-Gobain aims to deliver a comprehensive Total Rewards package that supports employees’ wellbeing and helps improve daily life for employees and their families. Be Well. Be You brings together inclusive programs and meaningful resources that support physical, emotional, financial, and social wellbeing. Employees have flexibility to choose the benefits that best fit their individual needs.

Health and wellbeing

* Medical, prescription drug, vision, and dental insurance
* Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options
* LiveWell Wellness Program
* Employee Assistance Program
* Paid time off and paid parental leave

Retirement and protection

* 401(k) with company match and Retirement Accumulation Plan cash balance pension plan
* Company provided life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment insurance, and short term disability
* Voluntary employee and dependent life insurance, long term disability, critical illness insurance, and accident insurance

Additional benefits

* Commuter benefits
* Group legal and identity theft protection
* Auto and home insurance
* Pet insurance and discounts
* Back up child and elder care
* PerkSpot Employee Discount Program
* Volunteer Day

We are the leading provider of worldwide smart end-to-end supply chain & logistics, enabling the flow of trade across the globe. Our comprehensive range of products and services covers every link of the integrated supply chain – from maritime and inland terminals to marine services and industrial parks as well as technology-driven customer solutions.

* Ensure that customer expectations are met and/or exceeded within the confines of company guidelines
* Quarterly presentations to customer senior management relative to our scorecard and initiatives
* Participate in customer invited meetings e.g. 9:30 am to support Customer strategic objectives
* Communicate with the customer and demonstrate initiatives supporting continuous improvement
* Meet company objectives with respect to Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, Morale and Environment
* Quarterly presentations to senior management of DP World re Plant objectives and initiatives
* Establish 5 year / contract life business plan, annual budgets and ensure targets are met
* Local initiatives to ensure plant progression in all regards

ADOPT CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT WITHIN THE WORKPLACE

* Plan and execute the concepts of lean manufacturing
* Ensure the plant plans and executes productivity tasks on an annual and ongoing basis
* Prioritize activities associated with the elimination of waste in all aspects of our operations

ORGANIZATIONAL STRENGTHENING

* Continue to build a stronger salaried team capable of leading the hourly workforce into the demands of the future
* Improve employee relations and morale through participation of personnel from the shop floor and instill behavioral discipline
* Improve communication throughout the organization and at all levels

NEW BUSINESS

* Work with the business development and account management group to identify business opportunities within the capabilities of the plant and local area
* Ensure the plant participates in all activities surrounding potential business and future profitability
* Ensure the plant is always in a state that maximizes its appeal to outsiders and potential customs

BE A CORPORATE CITIZEN, CREATE AN EXTERNAL IMAGE

* Ensure that DP World is a positive force within the community and considered to be a good employer
* Increase the exposure of DP World in a positive light to maximize our opportunity for future growth
* Work with other suppliers and industry focus groups in the local community to learn from their experiences and adapt accordingly

QUALITY & ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS

* Participate as an active member of the management team in supporting ISO 14001 and ensuring that their direct reports abide by these processes and operating work instructions
* Drive, Attend and participate in both ISO TS 16949 and ISO 14001 management review

**QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS**

* A college or university degree related to manufacturing is preferred and /or MBA
* At least seven years of progressively responsible operational leadership experience in logistics, warehousing, manufacturing, or comparable environments, including at least three years managing managers or site leadership teams. Comparable relevant experience may be considered.
* Job experience in a Tier 1 operation is beneficial
* A production, materials and quality control background compliment skill set

***Please note****: This position does not offer sponsorship for employment visas. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in The United States without sponsorship now or in the future.*

**ABOUT DP WORLD**

Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the world’s trade flow better, changing what’s possible for the customers and communities we serve globally.

With a dedicated, diverse and professional team of more than 115,000 employees from 160 nationalities, spanning 78 countries on six continents, DP World is pushing trade further and faster towards a seamless supply chain that’s fit for the future.

We’re rapidly transforming and integrating our businesses - Ports and Terminals, Marine Services, Logistics and Technology – and uniting our global infrastructure with local expertise to create stronger, more efficient end-to-end supply chain solutions that can change the way the world trades.

What's more, we're reshaping the future by investing in innovation. From intelligent delivery systems to automated warehouse stacking, we’re at the cutting edge of disruptive technology, pushing the sector towards better ways to trade, minimizing disruptions from the factory floor to the customer’s door.

DP World is on a mission to transcend boundaries and bridge the gap between all nations and cultures – not just in what we do but also in how we behave.

We are dedicated to creating a culture where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to reach their full potential. We believe that embracing inclusion and diversity, drives innovation and growth and helps us connect people, businesses, and societies. new_roles.description:
Who is Swire Coca-Cola? We are a family-owned bottling company with a story spanning over two centuries. We are one of the largest bottlers of Coca-Cola in North America and distribute more than 50 beverage brands and flavors creating joy for our customers every day. Our 8,000+ driven employees work hard as part of a team that delivers refreshment to over 30 million consumers across 13 states. Begin a journey with us at Swire Coca-Cola and belong to a community of dedicated team members who think big and believe in winning together.
 
 
**Job Details:** 
**Job Level:** 7
 
 
**Why you’ll love working at Swire Coca-Cola:** 
Swire Coca-Cola is committed to providing balance to support you in all aspects of your life, both at work and beyond. We offer the benefits you need for physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
 
 

* Health coverage (3 medical options, dental and vision). 401(k) Retirement Plan w/company match
* Health Savings Accounts w/company match
* FREE virtual primary care, acute care and physical therapy
* FREE Employee Assistance Program
* Company paid (vacation, holidays, sick time, bereavement, jury duty, maternity/parental, disability leave and volunteer time)
* Discounted & free product
* Tuition reimbursement
* Opportunities for career advancement

In addition to health benefits, Swire Coca-Cola is proud to offer you opportunities where you help give back directly to the communities and causes you care about. Note: Enrollment in a Swire Medical Plan is required for some benefits.
 
 
What does a Sr. Quality Manager do at Swire Coca-Cola?
 
Lead the Manufacturing Quality discipline at a manufacturing plant level to ensure that plant is operating to the Coca-Cola KORE standards and that all products produced maintain the highest standards of consumer quality for brand integrity.
 
 
**Responsibilities:** 

* Develop, guide and measure the in-plant quality standards that must be met to manufacture products that meet all KO and industry standards for consumer consumption
* Hire, train, and mentor Quality Lab Technicians and Lab/Sanitation Supervisors at the plant level to ensure they are qualified to perform all the quality processes and procedures required to deliver quality product to consumers
* Guide the creation and maintenance of documentation, processes, and procedures to fully comply with all KO KORE standards requirements, as well as any other industry/regulatory requirements for quality in manufacturing at the plant level
* Establish and maintain strong associations with other Coca-Cola bottlers in the Quality Management space in order to effectively learn best practices, provide guidance/counsel where appropriate, and be aware of changing trends and requirements that must be implemented at the plants
* Proactively develop relationships with local and state government agencies responsible for managing water usage and quality standards, discharge standards, etc
* Performs other duties as assigned

**Requirements:** 

* High School Diploma (or GED) required and
* College degree preferred in chemistry, biology, preferred or related science field
* 4+ years' experience in Quality Management in a food manufacturing industry – soft drink preferred
* Strong understanding of the science of soft drink production at the base molecular level
* Strong knowledge of industry quality standards for manufacturing of food grade products
* Specific knowledge of all state and local standards and requirements for water quality and raw materials for food grade production
* KO KORE and ISO quality standards in a soft drink environment

Come and join our Sparkling team!

This includes a criminal background check, drug screening, and for certain roles, a motor vehicle record review.
 
 
Screening results are evaluated based on several factors, including the nature and severity of an offense, how much time has passed, the relevance to the position, patterns of repeated offenses, and driving history for roles that require operating a vehicle.
 
 
All results are reviewed fairly and in accordance with applicable state and federal laws, including the Fair Credit Reporting Act.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Production Planning & Control (PP&C)
new_roles.description:
**About Hirsh Precision**
-------------------------

Hirsh Precision is a leader in U.S. manufacturing, bringing productivity and product innovation to medical, aerospace, industrial, and scientific markets through software, advanced manufacturing techniques, and modern production systems. Our reputation for integrity, quality, service, and excellence is powered by a passionate, engaged team and a culture focused on work that improves people’s lives.

**Role Snapshot**
-----------------

As the Senior Manager, Production Planning & Control (PP&C), you will orchestrate end-to-end planning operations that keep our factory synchronized—from MRP and buy planning to inventory control, warehousing, and logistics. You’ll shape the planning strategy, lead a high-performing team, and ensure schedules, materials, and capacity align to deliver on time, every time.

### **What you’ll do**

* Own and execute MRP activities, including buy planning, material master data stewardship, warehousing, and logistics coordination.
* Partner closely with Production, Engineering, Quality, and Finance to align planning strategies to business goals.
* Lead continuous improvement to increase affordability while safeguarding performance and quality.
* Build, mentor, and develop a top-performing team through training, coaching, performance assessments, and recognition.
* Create and manage production schedules to optimize capacity utilization and meet on-time delivery commitments.
* Monitor shop orders, production priorities, and work center schedules, adjusting proactively as conditions change.
* Collaborate with Operations, Purchasing, and Sales Operations to anticipate and resolve material, labor, and equipment constraints.
* Act as the primary escalation point for all scheduling-related issues.
* Advance scheduling processes, tools, reporting, and overall efficiency via continuous improvement.
* Maintain pristine scheduling data integrity within BPCS and generate KPI dashboards, performance reports, and metrics.
* Provide senior-level insights and reporting to executive stakeholders.

### **A week in the role might look like**

* Kick off with an S&OP alignment touchpoint; validate demand signals and capacity models.
* Review MRP outputs; firm planned orders and buy plans; resolve exceptions with Purchasing.
* Walk the floor with Operations to assess bottlenecks; rebalance work center loads and update priorities.
* Host a cross-functional huddle with Engineering and Quality to mitigate risks on critical programs.
* Publish schedule health KPIs from BPCS and brief leaders on variances and corrective actions.
* Coach a planner on data-governance best practices; recognize wins in a team standup.

### **Basic qualifications**

#### **Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Industrial Engineering, or a related field
* APICS/ASCM certification (CPIM)

#### **Experience**

* 8–12 years of progressive experience in manufacturing planning, supply chain, or operations management
* At least 3 years leading multi-disciplined teams

#### **Technical proficiency**

* Hands-on with mid- and upper-tier ERP systems
* Strong analytical capability, KPI dashboard development, and data-governance expertise

#### **Leadership competencies**

* Clear, influential communicator with stakeholder management strength
* Demonstrated talent development and mentorship capability

#### **Other core skills**

* Data-driven problem solving
* Change management expertise
* Continuous-improvement mindset

#### **Desired skills**

* Strategic execution—able to think long-term while delivering hands-on results
* Mentorship & team building—coaching, developing high-performing teams, and succession planning
* Business acumen—translate data into actionable insights that drive cost savings and operational excellence
* Collaboration—excel in matrix environments; foster cross-functional partnerships and knowledge sharing
* Innovation mindset—champion new tools, processes, and best practices that elevate PP&C performance

### **Tools you’ll use**

* ERP & MRP Systems
* ERP Software (including BPCS for scheduling data integrity and reporting)

new_roles.title: Manager / Senior Manager, Technical Operations
new_roles.description:
ARS Pharmaceuticals is a fast-growing, innovative company dedicated to transforming the treatment of severe allergic reactions with **neffy®**, the first and only FDA-approved needle-free epinephrine product. If you're motivated to make a meaningful impact, this is your opportunity to join a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and inclusive culture.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

 

The Manager / Sr. Manager, Technical Operations will play a key role in executing Technical Operations programs that support the continued development and commercial supply of neffy™. The successful candidate will combine strong technical judgment, project management, and external partner leadership in a highly collaborative environment.

Working closely with internal stakeholders and CMOs, this role provides technical and operational leadership across the ARS outsourced manufacturing network. Responsibilities include leading Technical Operations projects, supporting formulation and process development, technology transfer, GMP manufacturing activities, and resolution of technical and operational issues. The position ensures project scope, timelines, deliverables, responsibilities, and budgets remain aligned while proactively identifying and escalating risks to support compliant, reliable, and on-time product supply.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Manage cross-functional Technical Operations projects and day-to-day technical and operational interactions with assigned external partners, including scope, timelines, deliverables, responsibilities, budgets, risks, key milestones, project meetings, action tracking, scopes of work, proposals, change orders, and CMO/vendor performance metrics and KPIs (e.g., service, quality, delivery, capacity, and right-first-time).
* Serve as a Technical Operations point of contact for assigned external manufacturing partners and work closely with CMOs and internal stakeholders to ensure execution against agreed project plans and supply requirements.
* Provide technical oversight of formulation and process development, scale-up, technology transfer, process characterization, process validation/PPQ, and continued process verification activities, as applicable.
* Plan and support clinical and commercial manufacturing campaigns in coordination with CMOs, Supply Chain, Quality Assurance, and other internal functions; provide on-site/person-in-plant support for key manufacturing activities as needed.
* Review manufacturing and process documentation, including master and executed batch records, protocols, reports, process performance data, vendor change controls, investigations, and annual/product reviews, for technical accuracy and process performance.
* Lead or support technical assessment and resolution of manufacturing deviations, out-of-specification or atypical results, and other process issues; contribute to root-cause analysis and appropriate corrective and preventive actions in partnership with Quality Assurance.
* Assess proposed manufacturing and process changes for technical impact and support cross-functional evaluation of quality, supply, and regulatory implications.
* Monitor and trend manufacturing and process performance data to identify emerging risks, process drift, and opportunities for continuous improvement and operational excellence.
* Support vendor selection, onboarding, and qualification activities in collaboration with Quality Assurance, Supply Chain, Procurement, and other stakeholders.
* Communicate project status, technical risks, manufacturing issues, and recommend actions clearly to Technical Operations leadership and cross-functional stakeholders; escalate significant issues to appropriate decision-makers.
* Support preparation and review of CMC information for regulatory submissions and responses to health authority questions, as required.
* Support Technical Operations process improvement, business continuity, capacity planning, and other strategic operational initiatives as assigned.
* Support commercial supply operations managed within Technical Operations, including coordination with third-party logistics (3PL) providers, distribution partners, and external manufacturing/packaging partners to maintain reliable product supply.
* Support product serialization activities, including EPCIS data exchange and operational compliance with applicable Drug Supply Chain Security Act (DSCSA) requirements, working with packaging, distribution, Quality Assurance, and other partners as appropriate.
* Support clinical supply activities, including coordination with Clinical Operations and external vendors for clinical packaging, labeling, distribution, inventory/expiry management, and Interactive Response Technology/Interactive Web Response System (IRT/IWRS) activities, as applicable.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:**

* Strong working knowledge of current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), pharmaceutical manufacturing operations, and applicable quality systems and regulatory expectations.
* Demonstrated technical understanding of formulation, manufacturing processes, scale-up, technology transfer, process validation, and process performance sufficient to critically evaluate CMO data and recommendations, work effectively in cross-functional technical teams, and hold external partners accountable to commitments.
* Strong project and vendor management skills, with demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, timelines, deliverables, and external partners in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to evaluate complex manufacturing or process issues, develop recommendations, and communicate the rationale for action.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively across functions and organizational levels, including senior management and external partners.
* Well-organized, detail-oriented, and able to identify and escalate risks while maintaining focus on execution and business priorities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project/reporting tools; experience with project management, continuous improvement, or operational excellence methodologies is a plus.
* Working knowledge of commercial and clinical supply operations relevant to Technical Operations, including 3PL interfaces, serialization/EPCIS and DSCSA requirements, and clinical IRT/IWRS processes; direct experience in one or more of these areas is preferred.
* Must be able to travel domestically and internationally up to approximately 20% to support external manufacturing partners and key project activities.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree in pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry, chemical engineering, engineering, or a related scientific/technical discipline; an advanced degree is a plus. An acceptable combination of education and relevant experience will also be considered.
* Minimum of 5 years of relevant pharmaceutical/biotechnology experience in Technical Operations, manufacturing, process/formulation development, CMC, supply chain, or a related function.
* Experience working with external CMOs/CDMOs and supporting GMP clinical and/or commercial manufacturing is strongly preferred.
* Experience with drug-device combination products, nasal/inhalation products, sterile manufacturing, commercial product launch, or PPQ is preferred.
* Experience reviewing manufacturing batch records and process documentation and supporting technical investigations, change controls, and regulatory CMC activities is preferred.
* Experience supporting commercial distribution/3PL operations, serialization/EPCIS and DSCSA compliance, and/or clinical supply and IRT/IWRS activities is preferred.

At ARS, we are proud to offer a highly competitive compensation & benefits package.

The full-time salary range for this posted position is $140,000 to $175,000and may be eligible for a discretionary annual performance bonus. Actual pay rates are determined by considering multiple factors including qualifications, relevance of experience, education & credentials, subject matter expertise, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

*This position is also eligible for Equity, 401k matching, and our excellent benefits package including 100% employer paid Medical, Dental & Vision for employees. View the full package here:* *ARS Careers Page*

*ARS Pharmaceuticals believes in Equal Opportunity for all and is committed to ensuring all individuals, including individuals with disabilities, have an opportunity to apply for those positions that they are interested in and qualify for without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic. ARS Pharmaceuticals is also committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals so that an individual can perform their job-related duties. If you are interested in applying for an employment opportunity and require special assistance or an accommodation to apply due to a disability, please contact us at careers@ars-pharma.com*

*The position will be posted until a final candidate is selected for the requisition or the requisition has a sufficient number of applications.*

new_roles.description:
**Position Purpose**

The Senior Manager leads the global Advanced Manufacturing Technology (AMT) organization and converts long-range technical direction into an executable three-to-five-year portfolio of technology, automation, equipment, and factory-transformation initiatives.

The role owns people leadership, portfolio execution, global capital-process stewardship, strategic vendor and technical-equipment vendor portfolio management, deployment, adoption, and business results.

**Principal Accountabilities**

**Strategy and Portfolio Leadership**

Translate enterprise strategy and technical direction into an executable AMT roadmap.

Prioritize initiatives using business value, readiness, risk, capacity, and strategic alignment.

Drive results across functions, regions, and multiple levels.

**Global Capital Process Custodianship**

Serve as custodian of the global capital process, including standard work, governance, review cadence, documentation quality, portfolio transparency, and continuous improvement.

Develop and quality-review investment plans, business cases, and Capital Expenditure Requests (CERs).

Provide the Vice President portfolio analysis and recommendations supporting global capital strategy and prioritization.

Manage assigned capital and operating budgets and ensure financial adherence.

**Global Vendor and Technical Equipment Portfolio**

Lead strategic relationships with key global manufacturing-technology and equipment vendors.

Create and maintain the technical equipment vendor portfolio, including preferred capabilities, technology coverage, performance, quality, delivery, risk, capacity, lifecycle support, and regional applicability.

Lead supplier development, technical reviews, commercial alignment, long-term service strategies, and executive escalation.

Use global portfolio leverage to improve standardization, innovation access, total cost, delivery, and support.

**Technology Deployment and Results**

Lead programs from concept approval through industrialization, qualification, deployment, adoption, and benefits realization.

Establish accountability for scope, schedule, budget, risk, and measurable outcomes.

Remove organizational barriers and ensure consistent execution across regions.

**Organization and Talent**

Lead, coach, and develop.

Build morale, productivity, innovation, learning, succession, and accountability.

**AMT Expansion Playbook**

Create and maintain the AMT expansion playbook covering organizational, people, technical, process, specification, vendor, equipment, installation, qualification, training, and readiness requirements.

Own the AMT workstream for expansion programs and ensure equipment and technology readiness at each stage gate.

**Nature and Scope**

The Senior Manager leads the global AMT organization with broad accountability for organizational capability, global capital-process stewardship, key vendor relationships, the technical-equipment vendor portfolio, technology investment execution, deployment, and measurable business outcomes across regions.

**Knowledge & Skills**

**Education & Experience**

Bachelor degree in Engineering required; advanced degree preferred.

12+ years in manufacturing technology, automation, industrialization, or related fields.

5+ years leading technical teams and complex cross-functional programs.

**Technical & Functional Expertise**

Manufacturing technologies, automation, controls, robotics, digital manufacturing, industrialization, equipment-vendor management, capital governance, and portfolio management.

Strong working knowledge of Lean and high-variation, low-volume manufacturing.

**Leadership & Business Competencies**

Compelling vision, stakeholder mobilization, financial acumen, talent development, change leadership, and three-to-five-year strategic planning.

**Working Conditions**

Office and manufacturing environments.

Standing and walking up to 50 percent; occasional lifting up to 30 pounds.

Domestic and international travel up to 30 percent.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Performance and Quality
new_roles.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

As the Senior Manager, Performance and Quality, you'll lead proposal development and formal client responses for the account, and coordinate the team's responses to client, external, and government audits. You'll turn complex contract, pricing, performance guarantee, and operational requirements into accurate, persuasive, on-time submissions. Every commitment and audit response you produce is supported, traceable, and clear to the client. In Finance and Contract Compliance, you'll link what proposals promise to how performance and quality are checked through audits and corrective action. You will also project-manage implementations and changes on the account.

**Primary responsibilities**
----------------------------

* Develop proposal strategies and response plans for renewals, RFPs, RFIs, client-requested program and benefit-change proposals, and contract amendments that align with account objectives and client requirements.
* Manage the end-to-end development and submission of proposals and formal client responses, from requirement intake through final review and delivery.
* Partner with account, executive, Finance, Legal, Clinical, and Operations leadership to define key messages and value propositions, and confirm that pricing, performance guarantee, and contract commitments are accurate and approved before submission.
* Write clear, persuasive, client-ready narratives and executive communications about capabilities, program results, and positions, and represent the team in client meetings on proposals and deliverables.
* Lead project management for implementations and account changes, such as new programs, vendor transitions, and benefit or system changes. Build and manage project plans for these and for RFPs, renewals, contract amendments, client deliverables, and audit responses, with timelines, milestones, owners, and dependencies. Plan for compressed client turnaround times and escalate at-risk items early.
* Research client needs, program developments, and market and competitive trends to inform proposal strategy and client recommendations.
* Implement standardized templates, content libraries, style guides, and quality checklists for proposals and audit responses, and train contributors to use them.
* Support contract negotiations during RFPs and amendments by coordinating redlines and negotiating items with Legal and leadership, and documenting each decision to keep, trade, or drop an item, with its approver, so the rationale stays on record.
* Own the audit request log and coordinate intake, scoping, ownership, and evidence production for client, external, and government audits of the account, including third-party audits triggered by performance guarantee escalation provisions.
* Perform quality reviews of audit responses and evidence packages to confirm every part of the request is addressed, amounts reconcile, and the response is clear to an independent reviewer; coordinate secure submission and retain final versions.
* Maintain internal corrective action plans (CAPs) for known contract breaches, so completed fixes are documented before the client asks, and lead the response when the client invokes the contract's formal CAP process. Track audit findings, management responses, fixes, and closeout against contract timelines, and report recurring performance and quality themes to leadership.

**Key deliverables**

**Summary of Position****:**

The Senior Quality Manager of Flight Line Quality Control Management, and Execution of Helicopter Flight Line of an FAA part 21 approved Quality System. The Senior Manager, Quality Control of Flight Line will ensure compliance and safety, balanced with cost in alignment with operations to safely bring aircraft to pre-flight, ground test, and flight testing. Driving the finalization process to the delivery and acceptance intent on ZERO defect aircraft being presented to customers. Provide technical leadership, leaning on knowledge of FAA P21 requirements, AS9100, and aerospace knowledge. The Senior Quality Manager of Flight Line, will also focus on personnel management and development, ensuring competencies equal to the business and market requirements. The Senior Manager will have a Continuous Improvement approach to processes while executing to the business plan.

* Safe and on time actions bringing Production Helicopters to Operation, Ground Run, Flights, Acceptance & Delivery to Customer
* Resource Management, deployment of resources, training and building out Competencies of resources to meet customer and market demand
* Ensure compliance of Quality System with all relevant, FAA guidelines, procedures and policies.
* Represents QC as the prime contact for customer delivery activities
* Proactive measures in the planning and execution of aircraft operations, customer Acceptance and Delivery activity
* Continuous Improvement: using methods like DMAIC, statistical analysis to understand and improve processes and contributing to the efficiency of the Flight Line Operation

**Qualifications for Position****:**

**A. Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aviation Management, or a related technical discipline

* 5+ years of management and Quality experience or Equivalent

The successful candidate will have a working knowledge of AS9100 QMS and FAA requirements. Experience in Lean/Six Sigma, and a demonstrated approach to the job is a must. Must be a Leader and Change Agent with sound fundamentals in Quality Principles in Aerospace and Continuous Improvement. This Leader must demonstrate the ability to engage with partners and shareholders to find solutions, in execution and process. The candidate mut also demonstrate the ability to engage with stakeholders at Executive levels, internally, and externally including customers from the commercial and defense sectors.

**D. Licensure/Certification**

* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt desired, Green belt required
* ASQ Certification highly desired
* FAA Airframe and Powerplant (A&P) License or verified military equivalent desired

US - Philadelphia

new_roles.description:
**New England Village**

**Position:** Senior Director of Quality, Compliance and Risk

**Location:** Pembroke, MA 02359 (on-site)

**Salary:** $105,000-$120,000 annually

**Position Summary**

New England Village is seeking an experienced Senior Director of Quality, Compliance & Risk to provide organization-wide leadership for quality management, regulatory compliance, risk management, accreditation readiness, policy governance, and continuous improvement.

This is a senior leadership role for a professional with substantial prior experience in quality management and regulatory compliance within a complex, highly regulated environment. The successful candidate will bring demonstrated experience leading quality and/or compliance functions and building systems that translate regulatory requirements, organizational findings, data, and risk into measurable and sustainable improvement.

The Senior Director works across programs and support departments to promote consistent standards, effective monitoring, clear accountability, regulatory readiness, and continuous improvement. Department leaders remain responsible for the quality, compliance, and performance of their respective areas, while the Senior Director provides the organizational framework, oversight, consultation, analysis, and escalation necessary to support enterprise accountability.

The Senior Director serves as New England Village's designated Compliance Officer, directly supervises the Director of Program Improvements & Supports and the Director of Program Implementation & Practice, and serves as a member of the Senior Leadership Team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and continuously strengthen the organization's quality management framework, including the Quality Management Plan, performance indicators, monitoring systems, trend analysis, corrective action, and continuous improvement.
* Serve as the organization's Compliance Officer and lead the continued development, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation of a formal enterprise compliance program.
* Maintain organizational readiness for licensing, accreditation, regulatory reviews, audits, surveys, investigations, inspections, and other external reviews.
* Establish and oversee effective approaches to internal quality and compliance review, risk assessment, root-cause analysis, corrective action, monitoring, and verification that improvements are sustained.
* Develop and maintain an organizational approach to identifying, assessing, mitigating, monitoring, and escalating significant regulatory, service, health and safety, privacy, financial, operational, and organizational risks.
* Analyze incidents, complaints, investigations, audit findings, corrective actions, regulatory findings, performance measures, and other data to identify patterns, systemic concerns, recurring issues, and emerging risks
* Lead and support effective policy and procedure governance, ensuring regulatory and organizational requirements are translated into practical and sustainable operations.
* Ensure significant findings result in meaningful corrective and improvement actions, with assigned accountability, measurable outcomes, follow-up, and evidence of effectiveness.
* Provide leadership and professional development to functions responsible for quality assessment, compliance monitoring, program improvement, implementation support, training, and practice fidelity.
* Work collaboratively with program and support leaders while maintaining the independence and objectivity necessary to identify concerns, challenge practices, and escalate significant or unresolved risk.
* Monitor changes in applicable regulatory and funding requirements and coordinate appropriate changes to policies, procedures, systems, training, monitoring, and organizational practices.
* Provide clear analysis, reporting, and recommendations regarding significant quality, compliance, regulatory, and risk matters to senior and executive leadership and designated Board committees.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in human services, healthcare administration, quality management, compliance, public administration, or a related field required; master's degree preferred.
* Minimum of seven years of progressively responsible experience in human services, healthcare, behavioral health, Medicaid-funded services, or a comparable highly regulated environment, including at least five years with significant responsibility for quality management, regulatory compliance, risk management, accreditation, or related organizational assurance functions.
* At least three years of progressive leadership experience, preferably including supervision of managers, senior professionals, or multidisciplinary functions.
* Knowledge of Massachusetts DDS and MassHealth requirements, with direct experience in IDD or comparable Massachusetts human services strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading a quality and/or compliance function, with responsibility for activities such as regulatory monitoring, internal review or audit, corrective action, quality improvement, investigations, risk assessment, or accreditation/licensing readiness.
* Demonstrated experience developing and operating formal quality or compliance systems, including monitoring plans, audit/review processes, corrective-action systems, quality measures, risk tracking, policies and procedures, and reporting to senior leadership.
* Demonstrated experience preparing an organization for licensing, accreditation, regulatory audits, surveys, investigations, or external reviews, including responding to findings and monitoring corrective actions through resolution.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze quality, compliance, incident, and operational data; identify systemic or recurring issues; conduct or guide root-cause analysis; and translate findings into measurable improvement.
* Experience presenting significant quality, compliance, and risk findings and recommendations to executive leadership, Boards or Board committees, regulators, auditors, accreditation bodies, or other external reviewers.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Excel, SharePoint, Microsoft Lists, Forms, and Teams, and experience using technology to improve monitoring, reporting, workflow, and accountability.
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in a related field.
* Direct professional experience supporting services regulated by Massachusetts DDS and/or MassHealth.
* Direct experience in IDD or comparable Massachusetts human services.
* Previous experience serving as a Compliance Officer or in a significant leadership role within a formal organizational compliance program.
* Experience developing or administering confidential reporting, complaint, investigation, and non-retaliation processes.
* Experience with CARF accreditation, Massachusetts DDS licensing, MassHealth audit readiness, or comparable accreditation and regulatory-review processes.
* Professional certification such as CPHQ, CHC, CCEP, Lean Six Sigma, PMP, or another relevant quality, compliance, risk, or improvement credential.
* Experience with Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, or comparable technology used to support monitoring, workflow, reporting, and organizational accountability

Sun Life U.S. is one of the largest providers of employee and government benefits, helping approximately 50 million Americans access the care and coverage they need. Through employers, industry partners and government programs, Sun Life U.S. offers a portfolio of benefits and services, including dental, vision, disability, absence management, life, supplemental health, medical stop-loss insurance, and healthcare navigation. We have more than 6,400 employees and associates in our partner dental practices and operate nationwide.

 

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

 

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

 

Visit our website to discover how Sun Life is making life brighter for our customers, partners and communities.

*DentaQuest manages dental and vision benefits for more than 33 million Americans. Our outcomes-based, cost-effective solutions are designed for Medicaid and CHIP, Medicare Advantage, small and large businesses, and individuals. With a focus on prevention and value, we aim to make quality care accessible to improve the oral health of all.*

**Job Description:**

**Location:** Sun Life embraces a hybrid work model that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility of virtual work. Our team members and leaders are expected to foster connection and teamwork by being present in the office at least 2 days per week.

 

**The opportunity:**

The Sr. Manager, Quality Assurance leads the Quality Assurance function within Dental Shared Services and is accountable for the consistent execution of quality monitoring, audit, calibration, reporting, and improvement activities across supported operations. This role manages quality teams and programs, translates performance data into actionable recommendations, and partners with Operations, Compliance, Training, Workforce Management, Client Engagement, Technology, and Business Process Outsourcing partners to strengthen controls, address risk, and improve member, provider, client, and business outcomes.

 
 

**How you will contribute:**

* Manage the day-to-day execution and continuous improvement of quality assurance programs across Dental Shared Services and supported operational functions, including Contact Center, Claims, Utilization Management, Provider Operations, Complaints and Grievances, Member Enrollment, Intake and Digital Services, and Vision operations.

* Establish and maintain audit procedures, sampling approaches, quality standards, calibration routines, and reporting practices aligned with contractual, regulatory, client, and internal control requirements.

* Lead, coach, and develop quality leaders and professionals by setting clear expectations, balancing workloads, monitoring productivity and accuracy, and supporting engagement, accountability, and career development.

* Analyze quality results, disputes, appeals, re-audits, and operational trends to identify root causes, emerging risks, and practical opportunities for improvement.

* Partner with Operations, Training, Workforce Management, Compliance, Client Engagement, Technology, and BPO leadership to develop and monitor corrective actions, coaching plans, training updates, and sustainable performance improvements.

* Manage client audit and calibration activities, including call and case selection, audit review, documentation preparation, meeting participation, follow-up, and timely response to client or regulatory inquiries.

* Coordinate quality support for internal, external, regulatory, and client audits; prepare evidence, contribute to management action plans, validate remediation, and track findings through closure.

* Implement quality improvement and technology initiatives, including automation, speech analytics, AWS Contact Lens, end-to-end review models, enhanced reporting, and expanded quality monitoring capabilities.

* Assess staffing, capacity, audit volumes, and competing priorities; recommend resource adjustments that support required coverage, service commitments, and cost-effective delivery.

* Maintain enhanced oversight for high-risk, high-profile, and penalty-impacting clients through targeted audit criteria, clear escalation paths, and proactive communication routines.

* Represent Quality Assurance in cross-functional forums, operational readiness activities, transformation projects, vendor discussions, compliance meetings, and leadership reviews.

* Prepare and present quality results, risks, recommendations, and improvement plans to business leaders, clients, and cross-functional partners.

* Promote a culture of accountability, compliance, continuous improvement, collaboration, and client-focused service delivery.

* Perform other duties as assigned.

 
 

**What you will bring with you:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Operations Management, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

* Seven or more years of progressive experience in quality assurance, healthcare operations, dental operations, contact center operations, claims, compliance, or related business operations.

* Three or more years of leadership or people management experience, preferably in a quality assurance, operations, or shared services environment.

* Experience supporting government, commercial, Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, or other regulated healthcare programs preferred.

* Strong knowledge of quality monitoring, audit methodology, calibration, root cause analysis, corrective action planning, internal controls, and performance improvement practices.

* Experience working with BPO partners, client audits, regulatory audits, and cross-functional operational teams preferred.

* Experience with reporting, dashboards, quality analytics, speech analytics, call recording tools, contact center platforms, or AWS Contact Lens preferred.

* Sound business judgment with the ability to connect quality performance to client, compliance, operational, and financial outcomes.

* Strong people leadership, coaching, performance management, and talent development skills.

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, determine root causes, and recommend practical solutions.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present findings, risks, and recommendations to leaders, clients, and cross-functional audiences.

* Strong project management, prioritization, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, deadlines, and competing priorities.

* Ability to influence without direct authority and build effective partnerships across Operations, Compliance, Training, Technology, Client Engagement, and vendor teams.

* Demonstrated ability to lead teams through change, implement standardized processes, and support technology-enabled transformation.

* High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, compliance, confidentiality, and ethical business practices.

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, SharePoint, and Teams.

 

**Salary:** $76,000 - 115,000

At our company, we are committed to pay transparency and equity. The salary range for this role is competitive nationwide, and we strive to ensure that compensation is fair and equitable. Your actual base salary will be determined based on your unique skills, qualifications, experience, education, and geographic location. In addition to your base salary, this position is eligible for a discretionary annual incentive award based on your individual performance as well as the overall performance of the business. We are dedicated to creating a work environment where everyone is rewarded for their contributions.

At Sun Life, we prioritize your well-being with comprehensive benefits, including generous vacation and sick time, market-leading paid family, parental and adoption leave, medical coverage, company paid life and AD&D insurance, disability programs and a partially paid sabbatical program. **Title:** **Sr Manager, GCP Quality Assurance**
================================================

Date: Oct 29, 2026

Location: Princeton, NJ

Company: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries, Inc (USA)

The Sr Manager, GCP Quality Assurance (Asset Lead) provides strategic quality oversight for assigned development programs within the Sun Pharma Global Development Organization (GDO) Branded Portfolio within Innovative Medicines. The role serves as the primary Quality asset representative to cross-functional global project teams and ensures compliance with applicable GXP regulations, company quality standards, and risk-based quality management principles across the clinical development lifecycle.

 

Key Responsibilities:

* Serve as the primary Quality representative for assigned assets/programs.
* Provide quality risk assessments and strategic recommendations to asset teams.
* Represents QA on the clinical and non-clinical teams; Quality Assurance oversight ensures compliance to regulations, guidance, local laws, and applicable ISO standards, TORO, approved protocol, study plans, risk management, safety and product quality reporting requirements and use of validated systems for patient safety, investigational product quality, and data integrity.
* Plans, conducts, and reports GCP audits of clinical trial sites, CROs, vendors, laboratories, internal processes, computerized systems, and regulatory submission documentation in accordance with applicable regulations and procedures.
* Ensures that the GCP Audit schedules are created and approved by QA management; create and execute audit plans that ensure compliance to applicable regulations, guidance/ guidelines, and standard operating procedures.
* Able to travel to conduct audits onsite at vendors’ facilities, service providers, clinical trial sites, and/or internal Sun systems. Proficient to read/write/review written regulatory submission documents to ensure the content is compliant to regulatory requirements. Performs For-cause/Directed Audits when assigned.
* Supports/ Leads company inspection readiness preparations and hosts inspector onsite and via remote tools; Serves as Sponsor QA to support Clinical Site inspections, as required
* Influence clinical development decisions through quality expertise. Assess quality implications of protocol amendments, study design changes, vendor strategies, and regulatory commitments. Collaborate with Outsourcing, Non-clinical, Clinical teams and functional departments (including clinical supplies and project managers) to support the selection of vendors and service providers based on risk evaluation thru audit; manage complex organizational issues, identify and implement organizational mitigations and/or process improvements.
* Escalate significant quality risks to senior leadership. Monitors quality metrics, audit observations, CAPAs, deviations, and critical quality events to identify emerging trends and risks. Provides regular reporting to senior management and develops proactive mitigation strategies in collaboration with functional stakeholders.
* Support the implementation of procedures and quality systems used to support the GDO Sponsored trials and for audit conduct of vendors, labs, clinical trial sites, and submissions dossiers.
* Travel requirement is 20% domestic and international

Requirements:

* BS Degree in Chemistry, Biology, or related scientific discipline; advanced degree preferred. A minimum of 10 years of experience in clinical research, clinical quality assurance, or GxP-regulated environments within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO, or clinical research organizations.
* Demonstrated expertise in ICH-GCP, FDA, EMA, ISO and global regulatory requirements.
* Experience supporting regulatory inspections and inspection readiness programs.
* Experience providing quality oversight to Phase I-IV clinical development programs.
* Strong risk-based quality management and stakeholder influencing skills; ability to communicate with technical and non-technical colleagues; experience establishing and maintaining effective relationships with leaders and peers.

* Demonstrated capability as organizational change agent. Ability to lead and participate on teams with shared responsibility for outcomes and decision-making.

The presently-anticipated base compensation pay range for this position is $150,500 to $183,500. Actual base compensation may vary based on a number of factors, including but not limited to geographical location and experience. In addition, this position is part of the Annual Performance Bonus Plan. Employees are eligible to participate in Company employee benefit programs which include medical, dental and vision coverage; life insurance; disability insurance; 401(k) savings plan; flexible spending accounts; and the employee assistance program. Employees also receive various paid time off benefits, including vacation time and sick time.

 

The compensation and benefits described above are subject to the terms and conditions of any governing plans, policies, practices, agreements, or other materials or documents as in effect from time to time, including but not limited to terms and conditions regarding eligibility. If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company, or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

new_roles.title: Sr. Director Operations Engineering - C&I
new_roles.description:
**We believe power is a promise - a shared commitment to be there for others when it matters most.**
====================================================================================================

For more than 65 years, we've turned big ideas into solutions that help protect homes, strengthen businesses and build a more resilient, efficient, sustainable energy future.

Ready to Power a Smarter World with us?

**Sr Director, Operations Engineering**
=======================================

The Sr Director, Operations Engineering is responsible for leading the enterprise Operations Engineering function with a focus on New Product Launches, Operations Integrations, Product Moves, and Operations Standards. This role ensures that new products, newly integrated operations, and transferred products are launched and sustained in manufacturing safely, on time, at quality, and at target cost. Through the development and deployment of enterprise standards, best practices, and the Generac Fulfillment System (GFS), the Director drives consistent, world-class execution across the Order-to-Cash process (Plan, Source, Make, Deliver & Service). The role partners closely with Engineering, Advanced Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, HR, and Business Unit leadership, and supports Generac's global manufacturing portfolio.

**Major Responsibilities**
--------------------------

### **New Product Launches (NPI)**

* Lead and coordinate the successful launch of New Product Introductions (NPI) within operations, from early design involvement through production ramp and sustained performance.
* Ensure manufacturing readiness for new products, including process design, PFMEA, line layout, tooling, fixtures, work instructions, and capacity planning.
* Partner with Product Engineering to drive design for manufacturability and assembly so new products launch with optimal cost, quality, and delivery.
* Establish launch gates, readiness criteria, and success metrics, and hold cross-functional teams accountable to them.
* Lead and support the introduction of new and revised processes and technologies that support cost reduction and competitive advantage.

### **Operations Integrations**

* Lead the operational integration of new sites, acquisitions, and expanded capacity into the Generac manufacturing network, aligning processes, systems, and performance expectations.
* Lead and contribute to facility transformation, including layout, mixed-model lines, value stream design, and deployment of the Generac Fulfillment System (GFS).
* Assess integrated facilities, infrastructure systems, and technology against best-in-class capability and develop roadmaps to close gaps.
* Coordinate cross-functional collaboration with HR, Finance, Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, and senior leadership to ensure integrations meet business objectives.
* Incorporate workplace optimization, space planning, and long-term facility planning into integration plans.

### **Product Moves & Transfers**

* Lead the planning and execution of product moves and technology transfers between facilities and with external supply chain partners, ensuring continuity of supply, quality, and cost.
* Own and continuously improve the product transfer procedure, and support the Operations Product Transfer Steering Committee to ensure alignment and adherence to the procedure.
* Develop transfer plans that include capacity validation, equipment and tooling relocation, process validation, training, and inventory bridge strategies.
* Partner with Business Unit and Manufacturing Strategy leaders to support footprint, rebalancing, and new capacity decisions with sound operations engineering analysis.

### **Operations Standards**

* Develop with corporate Advanced Manufacturing, deploy, and sustain enterprise operations engineering standards, policies, procedures, and process documentation that drive consistent execution across all facilities.
* Drive significant contributions to the implementation of the Generac Fulfillment System (GFS) across the Order-to-Cash process.
* Develop and implement operating methodologies designed to maximize floor space utilization, asset uptime and utilization, eliminate waste, and reduce operating cost.
* Champion lean principles and continuous improvement, and ensure the ongoing success of process improvement initiatives.
* Establish and monitor KPIs to evaluate productivity, engineering output, launch performance, and facility efficiency, using data to drive improvement.
* Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and environmental standards, and incorporate sustainability and energy efficiency initiatives.

### **Project Management & Financial Stewardship**

* Drive and project manage major cost, quality, and delivery initiatives, with a strong focus on breakthrough process and technology improvements.
* Facilitate project flow through regular engagement with engineering, manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams, managing shifting priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Oversee capital projects related to launches, integrations, and product moves, and provide budgetary figures for future fiscal year planning.
* Manage the operations engineering budget and support reduction of the operating cost of each facility consistent with company objectives.

### **Leadership & Talent Development**

* Lead the Operations Engineering team, including project planning, technical guidance, and resource allocation across sites and initiatives.
* Select, coach, and develop a high-performing team of engineers and project managers, setting objectives that align with company strategy.
* Manage organizational talent through performance management, succession planning, and development, ensuring feedback is consistently delivered and performance is systematically improved.
* Provide guidance to cross-functional teams and leadership on key decisions related to investment in core manufacturing technologies, processes, and systems.

**Minimum Job Requirements**
----------------------------

* **Education:** Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial) or Industrial Technology.
* **Work Experience:** 10+ years of related experience in Operations Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, and Production, including leading new product launches and product transfers.
* **Leadership Experience:** 5+ years of increasing responsibility for project and/or people management involving a broad range of operational technologies and processes.

**Knowledge / Skills / Abilities**
----------------------------------

* Strong knowledge of New Product Development, PFMEA, and operations engineering principles.
* Knowledge of lean principles, continuous improvement, and end-to-end supply chain principles.
* Experience operating in both high-mix, low-volume and high-volume, low-mix production environments.
* Ability to assess and manage end-to-end processes and to manage strategic and tactical issues by being hands-on.
* Ability to develop and deploy standards and best practices across multiple sites.
* Ability to attract, develop, and manage an impactful team.
* Demonstrated skills in problem solving, conflict resolution, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Excellent organizational, written, and oral communication skills, including the ability to influence senior leadership.
* Proven ability to prioritize multiple projects with shifting priorities and moving deadlines.
* Proficiency in a CAD platform (AutoCAD, SolidWorks, and/or ProE), MS Office, and ERP platforms.

**Preferred Job Requirements**
------------------------------

* Master's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering.
* Project Management certification (e.g., PMP).
* Experience deploying processes and standards at an enterprise level, both internally and with external supply chain partners.
* Experience leading operations integrations, facility transformations, and multi-site product transfers.
* Experience working in an international company and in matrix organizations, with multi-site support experience.
* Previous experience using SAP or an equivalent ERP.
* Experience with facilities engineering and with using and/or implementing CMMS systems.
* Large-scale project management experience.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Test Engineering
new_roles.description:
**We believe power is a promise - a shared commitment to be there for others when it matters most.**
====================================================================================================

For more than 65 years, we've turned big ideas into solutions that help protect homes, strengthen businesses and build a more resilient, efficient, sustainable energy future.

Ready to Power a Smarter World with us?

Generac Home is hiring a Senior Manager, Manufacturing Test Engineering. In this role you will lead Manufacturing Test organization responsible for manufacturing test strategy, automated test equipment, test software development, production data systems, engineering laboratories, and factory test deployment. This leader will be primarily working on Home product portfolio that involves our Solar & Storage, Interconnect Controls & PowerGen products.

You will lead and manage a multidisciplinary team of software developers, test engineers, designers, and technicians supporting PCBA Functional Test, End-of-Line (EOL) Test, Safety Test, and Run-In/Burn-In systems across internal and contract manufacturing sites.

Preferred location: Reno NV, (Santa Moncia OR Waukesha WI as options)

**Essential Responsibilities:**

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and develop a team of manufacturing test engineers, software developers, and designers.
* Establish organization strategy, technical roadmaps, staffing plans, and annual objectives.
* Manage departmental budgets, capital investments, contractors, and external suppliers.
* Drive a culture of technical excellence, innovation, safety, and continuous improvement.

**Manufacturing Test Engineering**

* Define manufacturing test strategies for power electronics, energy storage, controls, and Clean Energy products.
* Lead development and deployment of PCBA Functional Test, End-of-Line Test, HiPot/Safety Test, and Run-In/Burn-In systems.
* Establish standardized test architectures, specifications, coverage requirements, and deployment processes.
* Support factory launches, production ramp-ups, and test-system transfers across manufacturing sites.

* Lead development of manufacturing test software and automation solutions.
* Oversee applications utilizing Golang, Python, C#, LabVIEW, Linux, PLCs, and industrial automation technologies.
* Ensure integration of test systems with MES, databases, traceability systems, and manufacturing infrastructure.
* Improve test coverage, uptime, first-pass yield, cycle time, and diagnostic capabilities through automation and software innovation.

**Data Analytics & Traceability**

* Lead development of manufacturing test dashboards, data pipelines, and analytics platforms.
* Drive use of ClickHouse, Grafana, Power BI, and other tools for yield, throughput, failure analysis, and factory performance monitoring.
* Establish data-driven approaches for root cause analysis, quality improvement, and production optimization.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Partner with Product Engineering, Firmware, Manufacturing, Quality, Reliability, Operations, and Supply Chain teams.
* Drive Design-for-Test (DFT) initiatives and manufacturing test readiness for new products.
* Lead manufacturing test support at internal factories and contract manufacturers globally

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering; Electrical, Computer Science, or related technical discipline.
* 10+ years of engineering experience in manufacturing test, automation, software development, or electronics manufacturing.
* 5+ years of engineering leadership experience.
* Experience with automated test equipment, production software, and high-volume manufacturing environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with energy storage, power electronics, inverters, or embedded systems.
* Experience with Golang, Python, C#, LabVIEW, Linux, SQL databases, and industrial communication protocols.
* Experience with SIL/HIL systems, automated test equipment, and production analytics platforms.
* Experience supporting NPI and contract manufacturing operations.
* Familiarity with CAN, Ethernet, RS-232, RS-485, and other embedded communication protocols.

No 3rd parties or agencies at this time.

Specific conditions of this job are typical of frequent and continuous computer-based work requiring periods of sitting, close vision, and the ability to adjust focus.

The DO’s primary purpose is to develop General Managers and restaurant management teams to build and increase sales over the previous year and improve profitability, while ensuring employee and guest satisfaction, without compromising the integrity or You First culture of the concept. The Director of Operations is responsible for the success of all First Watch operations within their span of control (5-8 direct reports and 200-300 employees).

* Leads operational activities for a group of First Watch Restaurants by performing the following in accordance with Company guidelines regarding management development, sales, and profitability, planning and customer and employee relations

* Promotes First Watch outside the restaurant

* Five to seven years of progressive leadership experience in multi unit restaurant industry operations
* Proven track record of achieving results and building & maintaining successful teams
* Passion for providing excellent service and quality
* Ability to partner and build relationships while demonstrating leadership and integrity and promoting team success
* Extensive knowledge of the principles, procedures, and best practices in the industry
* Ability to work well under pressure in a fast paced, dynamic environment
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel frequently within assigned market

* Ability to forecast and analyze business trends to maximize territory performance and profitability
* Ability to create and maintain a budget
* Travel within the required territory (5 days in the field)

**Why We Stand Out**

Seeking a career-defining opportunity where your leadership, strategic vision, and client expertise are recognized and rewarded? Kaufman Rossin might be just the place for you.

As one of the top accounting firms in the country, our foundation is “people first.” In the words of James Kaufman, “we prioritize our people, their development, and their well-being. Our values are translated into action every day.”

Kaufman Rossin is a privately owned, independent public accounting firm, which means we are not beholden to outside investors or private equity influence. This independence allows us to prioritize long-term client relationships, maintain objectivity in our advisory approach, and make strategic decisions that benefit our people and clients, not external stakeholders. Our structure fosters agility, entrepreneurial thinking, and a collaborative culture where leadership is accessible, and innovation is encouraged.

Celebrated as the Best Place to Work in South Florida over a dozen times, Kaufman Rossin has grown to over 700 employees, with offices spanning the tri-county area, including sister entities Kaufman Rossin Wealth and Kaufman Rossin Alternative Investment Services.

**Think you have what it takes?**

**How You'll Contribute**

Kaufman Rossin is seeking a **Director of Operations** to lead firm-wide initiatives, strengthen operational practices, and turn strategy into execution. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer and partnering closely with the Chief Information Officer and firm leadership, you’ll lead our project managers and business analysts while driving technology implementations, process improvements, and organizational change.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who enjoys understanding how the business works, staying close to the details, and improving the experience of our clients and colleagues.

* Lead and develop project managers and business analysts, setting priorities, removing roadblocks, and ensuring consistent, high-quality delivery.
* Oversee multiple firm-wide initiatives, balancing scope, timelines, resources, and business impact while staying actively involved in requirements, planning, testing, and rollout.
* Lead the operational side of technology implementations, from selection and requirements through deployment, adoption, and ongoing optimization, in partnership with the CIO and IT team.
* Drive change management through communication, training, and adoption planning, recognizing how people and culture influence success.
* Develop and maintain policies, procedures, and best practices, and implement process improvements across departments.
* Establish business plans, key performance indicators, and performance targets; monitor results through reporting, audits, and scorecards.
* Ensure compliance with professional standards, regulatory requirements, and internal quality programs while identifying and addressing operational risks.
* Oversee team hiring, staffing, training, performance discussions, and career development, fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Manage budgets, forecasts, and the financial performance of operational initiatives, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and profitability.
* Partner with the COO and firm leadership on strategic and growth initiatives that enhance the client and colleague experience.

 
**Requirements**

**How You'll Contribute**

* 7+ years of related operations, project, or program management experience.

* 10+ years of supervisory leadership experience, ideally managing project managers, business analysts, or similar teams.
* Demonstrated success leading technology implementations and organizational change, with a strong understanding of the process from requirements through adoption.
* A hands-on leadership style, strong emotional intelligence, and the ability to manage multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong analytical, organizational, negotiation, and problem-solving skills, supported by sound judgment.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with partners, executives, and staff.
* Proficiency with project management and operational reporting tools.
* Availability for occasional travel to support leadership alignment, training, and firm-wide initiatives.

**How You'll Stand Out**

* Experience in professional services, particularly accounting, finance, risk management, or consulting.
* Bachelor’s degree.
* PMP, Prosci, Lean Six Sigma, or similar certifications.
* Experience with Microsoft Office, Salesforce, Domo, Power BI, or generative AI tools.

 
**Benefits**

***We embrace authenticity.*** *Kaufman Rossin is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating a culture that reflects the diversity of our firm and clients. We encourage understanding, acceptance, and celebration among all people. That includes lifestyle, education, experience, race, ethnicity, age, religion,* *physical ability, sexual orientation, and gender identity.* ***Differences make unique varieties.***
