new_roles.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing! 
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Does the thought of joining one of the fastest-growing, privately held data center companies sound exciting to you? Do you enjoy collaborating with team members to drive and operate some of the industry’s leading and most innovative infrastructure solutions?

At **Aligned Data Centers**, not only do we celebrate success across our platform, we celebrate the very teams that drive and support that success! Our culture is founded in passion, engineered from innovation, and driven by the pursuit of operational excellence. We are a company dedicated to driving positive change in the industry through continuous data center innovation, diversity and inclusion, and corporate sustainability.

We realize not only is providing a comprehensive benefits package important, but we also provide a generous 401k match with immediate vesting, free membership to Gympass which provides our employees a rich health and wellness benefit and competitive time off plan. Giving back and having fun is important to our team whether it be serving our communities or employee and customer events. ***Our Aligned DNA is what makes us unique and successful!***

**JOB DESCRIPTION:**

The Director Operations is responsible for leading and executing all aspects of the campus operations to include safety, security, reliability, network environment, customer relations, the critical environment, and P&L. This role will strategize, manage, and operate multiple Datacenter facilities for Aligned. 
The Director of Operations will ensure all Datacenter facility systems meet or exceed industry standards for critical maintenance resulting in 100% uptime, ensures the building engineering and security teams follow all reporting and documentation processes and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and meets all customer service level agreements and compliance audits. The Director of Operations will serve as the liaison for all 24x7 operational activities across their managed facilities with executives and department heads to ensure appropriate communications with all interested and vested parties. They will lead and direct the staff in their market to optimize employee potential and maximize Aligned’s continued growth in existing and new markets. This role reports to the SVP of Operations or their designee.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Provides senior leadership to drive strategic vision for Aligned’s datacenters, including Critical Facilities Operations, Preventative Maintenance, Commissioning, Infrastructure, Service Delivery, Security, Logistics, and Safety on a Senior level.
* Manages Campus operations of the 24x7 Datacenter environment. Identifies and implements critical metrics necessary to manage and monitor the performance of overall operations including, but not limited to, capacity, availability, budget, and inventory. Oversees all electrical and mechanical infrastructure such as UPS systems, generators, fire suppression systems, BMS, and HVAC systems Has responsibility for meeting established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Ensures that all work performed within the Datacenter is done to high quality and without impact to any internal/external customers.
* Oversees requirements and delivery of services provided by Operations, Security, and Safety. Drives maximum potential of these functions to provide exceptional services to clients and employees.
* Oversees and supports the level 5 commissioning, operations, and maintenance of all Datacenter mission critical infrastructure in order to achieve 100% availability. Manages Datacenter facility expansion and consolidation.
* Manages, coaches, and develops management team performing Datacenter operations.
* Manages and leads vendor relationship to maintain day to day operations and strategic goals for Datacenter Operations SLA’s and deliverables. Works with current vendor stakeholders and partners to develop and deliver strategic plans. Oversees all Datacenter vendor contracts, streamlining services required and optimizing overall costs.
* Will work closely with all strategic supply chain vendors to ensure Aligned’s lean management strategies and continuous innovation and process improvement are fully implemented.
* Evaluates and mitigates risk on new and existing programs within datacenter program governance.
* Develops opportunities for cross-team effectiveness and remove organizational barriers for strong teamwork, collaboration, and excellent service delivery.
* Drives Aligned’s Sustainability Strategy and creates a program to improve the efficiency of the Datacenter operations.
* Engages in improvement projects, which often requires reaching out to a variety of support teams and driving them from conception to completion.
* Manages budgeting and forecasting, planning, deployment, incident and problem management, change management.
* Maintains documentation and diagrams capturing all essential parameters of Datacenter operations.

new_roles.title: Community Operations Director
new_roles.description:
Job Summary:

This role serves as a cross-functional operational leader, working collaboratively across the organization to define, optimize, and standardize business processes and operating procedures. It involves partnering with system end-users to design efficient workflows, implement cross-functional process improvements, and documenting operational policies. The role actively contributes to system and operational enhancement efforts by collaborating with Product, Technology, and Clinical leadership, ensuring technology is effectively leveraged to support business needs. It requires strong leadership, communication, and negotiation skills to influence operations across departments, foresee enterprise-level implications of changes, and manage risks and issues through resolution. With strong organizational and time management abilities, this individual provides operational expertise to market leadership, supports execution of P&L goals, and serves as a subject matter expert and guide to peers and teams across the enterprise.

Salary Range: $110,000 - $175,088

Job Description:

* Dyad partner to the CMD bringing together operational and clinical excellence to lead the community.
* Work collaboratively across the business to define, optimize, and evolve standard operating procedures and business process standardization across the enterprise
* Work with system/technology end-users to develop optimal system workflows to enable desired business process; Identify and implement cross-functional process improvements
* Document operational policies and procedures
* Working collaboratively with Product leadership, leverage understanding of business process to participate in future requirements gathering for system or operational enhancements or selection, across the enterprise
* Collaborate with Product, Technology and Clinical leadership to optimize and maximize use of selected technology
* Lead, persuade, influence, and negotiate with respect to market operations, as well as within Operations Department and among other supporting departments
* Understand and foresee enterprise/company implications of subtle detail changes
* Track issues/risks and follow through on resolution with departmental leads; Strong verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills, including demonstrated ability to communicate effectively and tactfully to internal and external stakeholders
* Possess highly effective time management and organizational skills to independently manage self to achieve multiple objectives and meet deadlines
* Work and collaborate effectively within a team environment; Contribute to organization’s growth and profitability by providing operational expertise to market leadership
* Serve in a leadership role, providing subject matter expertise, guidance, and direction to team and peers.
* For P&L, remains consulted and informed and is responsible for executing against the goals and targets.

Job Requirements:

**Required Qualifications:**

**Education:** Bachelor’s Degree preferred, but candidates may be considered with 7-10 years' work experience in healthcare operations (physician practice and/or home health operations preferred)

**Experience:** Experience working with electronic health record (EHR) technology systems required; Previous supervisory experience required; Experience with process improvement and lean six sigma methodologies required; Experience with use of various software packages, such as MS Office, including MS Visio required; Must have excellent written and verbal communication, organizational, and analytical skills

**Skills:** Experience working with electronic health record (EHR) technology systems required; Previous supervisory experience required; Experience with process improvement and lean six sigma methodologies required; Experience with use of various software packages, such as MS Office, including MS Visio required; Must have excellent written and verbal communication, organizational, and analytical skills.

**Physical and Mental Requirements**

* Ability to lift up to 20 lbs.
* Ability to stand/sit for extended periods.
* Visual acuity and fine motor skills.
* Ability to travel to locations as needed.

**Travel:** up to 25% required (overnight)

**Work Environment:** Hybrid

**Pay Range:**

**MIN** - $124,000

**MID** - $160,000

**MAX** - $195,300

**Bonus:** 20%

**Sponsorship Statement**

WellBe does not offer employment-based visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.

**Pay Transparency Statement**

Compensation for this position will be disclosed in accordance with applicable state and local pay transparency laws.

**Drug Screening Requirement** 
As a condition of employment, WellBe Senior Medical requires all candidates to successfully complete a pre-employment drug screening. Ongoing employment may also be contingent upon compliance with the company’s Drug-Free Workplace Policy, which includes random, post-accident, and reasonable suspicion of drug testing. The company reserves the right to test for substances that may impair an employee’s ability to safely and effectively perform their job duties.

**Background Check Statement**

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, as permitted by law. As a healthcare organization, WellBe conducts monthly FACIS (Fraud and Abuse Control Information System) checks on all employees. Continued employment is contingent upon satisfactory results of these checks, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

**Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement**

WellBe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

**Americans with Disabilities Act**

WellBe Senior Medical is committed to complying with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. If you require an accommodation during the application, interview or employment process, please contact Human Resources at HRPeopleLine@wellbe.com

**At-Will Employment Statement**

Employment with WellBe is at-will unless otherwise specified by contract. This job description does not constitute an employment contract.

**Disclaimer**

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties as necessary.

existing_roles.title: Program Director - Quality & Customer Success
existing_roles.description:
As **Program Director - Quality & Customer Success**, you'll report directly to the Executive Vice President of the Intelligence Portfolio. This role oversees quality assurance and customer success. The Program Director removes delivery impediments, strengthens collaboration across teams, ensures compliance with contract requirements, and advocates for successful customer outcomes.

We know that you can't have great technology services without amazing people. At MetroStar, we are **obsessed** withour people and have led a two-decade legacy of building the best and brightest teams. Because we know our future relies on our deep understanding and relentless focus on our people, we live by our mission: A passion for our people. Value for our customers.

If you think you can see yourself delivering our mission and pursuing our goals with us, then check out the job description below!

**What you'll do:**

* Constantly monitor project progress to identify impediments early on, actively engage in resolving them, and 
 escalate issues when necessary.
* Manage and track dependencies across cross-functional teams or squads to ensure seamless collaboration and 
 timely delivery.
* Oversee and track all high-integrity commitments, ensuring they are met according to established timelines and 
 standards.
* Provide proactive visibility into project status, communicate delivery targets, commitments, and progress 
 effectively to stakeholders.
* Define, implement, and administer program deliverables to ensure full compliance with contract requirements. 
 Regularly report progress on problem resolution to senior management, highlighting any critical issues or 
 roadblocks.
* Foster a culture of team-driven decision-making and commitment, promoting trust among team members and 
 facilitating team-building events.
* Support customer meeting preparation and delivery and assist with escalations.
* Perform any other duties as assigned by senior leadership to support the overall objectives of the organization

**What you'll need to succeed:**

 

* Active TS//SCI with ability to obtain CI poly
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
* 10+ years of quality assurance experience, including at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* Proven success implementing and managing quality assurance processes and practices.
* Strong understanding of software development methodologies and quality assurance principles.
* Demonstrated ability to identify and resolve delivery impediments, manage dependencies across teams, and escalate critical issues.
* Experience overseeing program deliverables to ensure compliance with contract requirements, timelines, and quality standards.
* Ability to track commitments and clearly communicate project status, delivery targets, risks, and resolution progress to stakeholders and senior leadership.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills, including supporting customer meetings and managing escalations.
* Strategic thinking and the ability to identify and prioritize improvements in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Ability to build trust, encourage team-driven decisions, and promote accountability across cross-functional teams.

 

SALARY RANGE: $185,000- $225,000

The salary range for this position is determined based on qualifications, skills, and relevant experience. The final salary offered will be determined based on several factors including:

* The candidate's professional background and relevant work experience
* The specific responsibilities of the role and organizational needs
* Internal equity and alignment with current team compensation
* This role is also eligible for additional compensation, subject to the terms and policies of MetroStar, which may include:
* + Performance-based bonuses
 + Company-paid training and/or certifications
 + Referral bonuses

**Application Deadline:** Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis until the position is filled; candidates are encouraged to apply as early as possible for full consideration.

**Additional Compensation**: This role may also be eligible for bonuses and/or additional incentives based on individual and company performance.

**Benefits**: All full-time employees are eligible to participate in our benefits programs:

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match
* Paid time off (PTO) and holidays
* Parental Leave and dependent care
* Flexible work arrangements
* Professional development opportunities
* Employee assistance and wellness programs

Like we said, **we are** big fans of our people. That's why **we offer** a generous benefits package, professional growth, and valuable time to recharge. Learn more about our company culture code and benefits. Plus, check out our accolades.

**Commitment to Non-Discrimination** 
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit and without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

**What we want you to know:**

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

existing_roles.title: Quality Management Director
existing_roles.description:
**Overview**

The Quality Management Director develops, implements, and maintains the hospital's Quality Management System in line with ISO 9001 and NIAHO standards. The director oversees the Quality Assurance/Performance Improvement (QAPI) program and keeps the hospital compliant with CMS Conditions of Participation and state requirements. The role leads survey and accreditation readiness, including mock surveys, tracers, and plans of correction. The director chairs or coordinates the quality committees, supervises the Quality and Compliance Associate, and monitors regulatory quality requirements. The director also oversees quality and patient safety data reporting, including dashboards and benchmarking, presented to the Medical Staff, Executive Leadership, and Board.

I. Minimum Qualifications:

A. Education:

1. Current licensure to practice as a Registered Professional Nurse in the State of Texas or equivalent degree in healthcare with a minimum of a baccalaureate degree. Master's degree in nursing, healthcare administration, quality management, or a related healthcare field preferred.

2. Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or higher) preferred.

3. Must have at least three (3) years of experience in management or quality improvement in an accredited acute care setting.

II. Knowledge and Skills:

1. Demonstrate knowledge and leadership skills to perform duties outlined in the job description

1. Must have strong knowledge of accrediting and regulatory agency requirements

2. Must have good problem solving, interpersonal communication and project management skills

3. Must be extremely detail-oriented with respect to documentation and communication

4. Able to read and interpret medical record documentation and hospital policies and procedures

5. Must have at a minimum proficient computer skills in using Microsoft computer programs (Word, Excel, PPT, etc.)

III. Personal/Physical Requirements:

1. Mental and physical health to meet demands of position

2. Must have respect for human dignity and cultural diversity

3. Demonstrates ability in use of verbal/written communication, and effectively communicate with patients, families, hospital staff, medical staff, and general public.

IV. Data Reporting Requirements:

1. Oversees and supports the data collection, validation, analysis, and submits required quality and patient safety data to regulatory, accrediting, and governmental agencies (e.g., CMS, Texas Health and Human Services, and the hospital's accrediting organization) within required timeframes, including all mandatory quality reporting program measures applicable to a rural hospital.

2. Ensures accuracy, completeness, and integrity of abstracted and reported data through routine audits, validation processes, and corrective action when discrepancies are identified.

3. Prepares and presents routine quality dashboards, scorecards, and trend analyses to the Quality Committee, Medical Staff, Executive Leadership, and Board of Directors, at least quarterly or as required.

4. Benchmarks hospital performance against state, regional, and national comparative data and identifies opportunities for improvement.

5. Maintains confidentiality of patient, and quality data in accordance with HIPAA, and hospital policy, and retains all reports and supporting documentation per record retention requirements.

V. Oversight Responsibilities:

1. Provides oversight of the hospital-wide Quality Management System, including the Quality Assurance/Performance Improvement (QAPI) program, and ensures ongoing compliance with ISO 9001, NIAHO, CMS Conditions of Participation, and applicable state requirements.

2. Oversees survey and accreditation readiness, including mock surveys, tracer activities, and the development, implementation, and monitoring of plans of correction following internal or external surveys.

3. Oversees the work of the Quality and Compliance Associate.

4. Leads and monitors performance improvement projects, applying Lean Six Sigma and other process improvement methodologies, and tracks project outcomes and sustainability.

5. Chairs or coordinates quality committees, ensures committee minutes, action items, and follow-up are documented, and reports quality oversight activities to the Chief Executive Officer and the governing body.

Pay: From $73,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* AD&D insurance
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

existing_roles.description:
**Director of Quality**

**Location**

Carmel, IN • Memphis, TN • St. Louis, MO • Malden, MO • Peoria, IL • Other Illinois locations

**Leadership**

Directly manages at least two quality team members

**Travel**

Regular travel to manufacturing facilities and business locations, as needed

Weaver Popcorn is seeking a seasoned quality leader ready to step into a broader Director-level role. The Director of Quality provides strategic and operational leadership for food safety, quality assurance, regulatory compliance, audit readiness, and continuous improvement across the organization’s food manufacturing operations. This leader will strengthen and standardize quality systems, develop quality talent, and partner with plant and business leaders to ensure products consistently meet company, customer, certification, and regulatory requirements.

This is a hands-on leadership role for an experienced food manufacturing quality professional who can set direction while remaining actively engaged with plant teams, audits, investigations, corrective actions, and day-to-day execution.

**HOW WILL YOU HELP US GROW?**
==============================

**Quality & Food Safety Leadership**
------------------------------------

* Develop and lead the company’s quality and food safety strategy, priorities, policies, procedures, and performance expectations across manufacturing locations.
* Ensure quality assurance and food safety programs are effectively implemented, maintained, verified, and continuously improved.
* Establish and oversee grain and popcorn quality standards from grower receipt and bulk storage through processing, bagging, and shipment, ensuring consistent quality controls throughout the supply chain.
* Provide visible leadership on the manufacturing floor through routine plant engagement, risk reviews, verification activities, and follow-up on quality concerns.
* Build a culture of accountability, prevention, compliance, and continuous improvement across Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, Sales, and other partner functions.

**SQF, Audits & Regulatory Compliance**
---------------------------------------

* Lead and maintain SQF certification programs, including system ownership, audit preparation, certification readiness, corrective actions, and ongoing compliance.
* Plan, lead, and oversee internal, customer, certification, and regulatory audits of food manufacturing facilities.
* Ensure timely closure of audit findings, nonconformances, corrective and preventive actions, and related verification activities.
* Lead cross-functional Food Safety/HACCP, risk assessment, prerequisite program, and food quality teams.
* Monitor applicable food safety and quality requirements and translate them into practical operating standards and controls.
* Ensure effective quality controls for bulk grain storage, bin holds and releases, sampling, testing, and corn disposition prior to processing, including compliance with applicable phytosanitary requirements.

**Quality Management Systems**
------------------------------

* Own the effective use and continuous improvement of quality management system software, including document control, audits, corrective actions, training records, verification, and reporting.
* Standardize quality documentation, specifications, procedures, policies, records, and reporting across facilities.
* Use quality data, trend analysis, and leading and lagging indicators to identify risk, establish priorities, and improve performance.
* Ensure effective controls for ingredient sampling, product verification, environmental monitoring, sanitation verification, traceability, and other core quality programs.
* Provide oversight of corn testing and laboratory quality programs, including mycotoxin testing, internal and third-party sample testing, review of test results, and appropriate product disposition based on quality and food safety requirements.

**People Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership**
----------------------------------------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop a quality team of at least two direct reports, with potential for broader team responsibility as the function grows.
* Set clear goals, define accountabilities, assess performance, strengthen technical capability, and create development plans for quality team members.
* Partner with Plant Managers and Operations leaders to resolve quality issues without compromising food safety, customer requirements, or regulatory compliance.
* Establish and enforce hold/release and product disposition standards, with authority to stop processing or bagging operations and place grain, ingredients, or finished product on hold when food safety or quality requirements are not met.
* Partner with Sales and Customer Service to respond to customer documentation requests, audits, samples, complaints, and quality-related inquiries.
* Lead investigations into customer complaints, product or process deviations, and recurring issues; ensure root cause analysis and sustainable corrective action.
* Oversee nonconforming material, product holds, rework, release, and disposition processes, partnering with Operations and suppliers to ensure timely resolution and prevent recurrence.
* Provide clear quality updates, risk assessments, recommendations, and performance reporting to senior leadership and other decision-makers.

**WHAT DO YOU NEED TO HAVE?**
=============================

* Bachelor's degree in food science, Food Safety, Microbiology, Chemistry, Biology, Engineering, or related fields.
* 8–10+ years of progressive quality or food safety experience in the food manufacturing industry.
* At least 5 years of people-management experience, including progressive supervisory and manager-level responsibility.
* Proven leadership of SQF certification programs and successful food manufacturing audits.
* Demonstrated knowledge of food safety principles, quality assurance procedures and policies, HACCP-based programs, risk assessment, corrective action, and preventive controls.
* Experience leading internal, customer, certification, and/or regulatory audits across food manufacturing environments.
* Hands-on experience with quality management system software and electronic quality records.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, develop teams, manage competing priorities, and drive consistent execution across locations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate quality risk and technical requirements to operational and executive audiences.
* Ability to travel regularly to manufacturing facilities and business locations, as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience in grain, corn, popcorn, milling, ingredient, or related agricultural processing.
* SQF Practitioner experience and formal training in HACCP, PCQI, internal auditing, root cause analysis, or preventive controls.
* Experience supporting multiple manufacturing sites or standardizing quality systems across locations.
* Experience with supplier quality, customer complaint management, environmental monitoring, traceability, recall readiness, and food defense programs.

**WHAT DOES SUCCESS LOOK LIKE?**
================================

* Consistent audit and certification readiness across facilities.
* Stronger standardization and adoption of quality systems, procedures, and records.
* Timely, well-documented corrective action with verified effectiveness.
* Reduced recurrence of quality issues and customer complaints through disciplined root cause analysis.
* A capable, accountable quality team with clear goals and development plans.
* Credible, practical partnership with Operations and business leaders while maintaining independent quality judgment.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT & SCHEDULE**
===============================

This role operates across office and food manufacturing environments and requires regular presence in production areas. The typical schedule is Monday through Friday; however, the Director of Quality must be available outside normal business hours, including occasional evenings or weekends, when operational, audit, customer, or food safety needs require support. Regular travel is expected based on business needs.

**HOW WILL WE HELP YOU GROW?**
==============================

* Competitive compensation.
* Three weeks of paid time off in the first year.
* 401(k) plan with a company match of 100% of employee deferrals up to 10%.
* Health, vision, dental, life, and disability insurance beginning the first day of the month following 30 days of employment.
* Education reimbursement of up to $15,000 per year.

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**
================================

Weaver Popcorn is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and associates. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to any status protected by applicable law.

*Aerospace is at a turning point — costs are rising, supply chains are strained, and old ways of building can't keep up. At Neon Aero, we're breaking that mold. We move fast, think big, and combine start-up agility with aerospace expertise to design, build, and scale aircraft in ways the industry has never seen. Our team leverages automation, AI-driven tools, and a fully connected digital backbone to accelerate innovation and reduce barriers to production.*

*Here, you won't just take a job — you'll help reinvent how the world flies. If you're ready to solve complex problems, push technology further, and work alongside some of the brightest minds in aerospace, this is your chance to make a real impact.*

Neon is looking for an Aerospace Quality Director to help build the quality systems, team, and operating discipline needed to take parts and assemblies from prototype into production. This role will lead the quality function across development, manufacturing, supplier quality, and production readiness, ensuring the company can scale with strong process control, repeatability, and compliance. You will play a key role in helping a growing aerospace organization move from fast iteration to reliable production without losing technical rigor.

### **Why This Role Matters**

* Help shape how a growing company scales from prototype builds to stable production.
* Build the quality foundation needed for repeatable manufacturing, stronger yields, and fewer escapes.
* Partner directly with engineering and manufacturing to improve design transfer, process readiness, and production execution.
* Lead the systems and team that drive inspection discipline, nonconformance control, corrective action, and supplier quality.
* Influence how production processes are defined, controlled, and improved as volume and complexity grow.
* Operate in a fast-paced environment where quality decisions directly affect hardware readiness, customer confidence, and operational scale.
* Work across office, lab, and production settings with direct visibility into how quality impacts the business.

### **What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, quality, manufacturing, aerospace, or a related technical field; equivalent professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Experience managing a growing department of direct reports responsible for all aspects of product and process quality.
* Significant progressive experience in aerospace quality, manufacturing quality, supplier quality, or quality systems leadership.
* Experience helping move parts, assemblies, or hardware programs from prototype into production.
* Experience building or improving quality systems in a growing manufacturing organization.
* Strong background in inspection planning, process controls, nonconformance management, and corrective action.
* Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain teams to improve quality and production readiness.
* Experience with supplier quality management and supplier issue resolution.
* Strong problem-solving skills, judgment, communication, and ability to drive accountability across teams.
* Ability to work across office, lab, and production environments.
* Ability to support periods of increased workload tied to builds, ramp activity, and issue resolution.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
* May be required to meet export control, ITAR, confidentiality, or site access requirements.

#### **Preferred**

* Advanced degree in a relevant technical discipline; equivalent professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* ASQ certification or equivalent quality credential.
* Experience with first article inspection, process validation, control plans, or production quality planning tools.
* Experience in high-growth aerospace, defense, or advanced hardware manufacturing environments.
* Experience building quality organizations during production scale-up.

### **Why Join Us**

* Work alongside elite engineering talent and innovators from across aerospace and tech.
* Be part of a team moving faster than the industry standard.
* Shape solutions that are lower-cost, autonomous, and scalable — the future of aviation.
* Competitive compensation, including equity participation, growth opportunities, and full health benefits (health, vision, dental, 401(k)) designed to support you in and out of work.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.*

**Position Title:** Director of Quality Assurance

**Department/Area:** Quality Assurance

**Reports to:** Senior Director of Quality Assurance

**Employment Status:** Full-Time; Non-Union

**EXCELLENT BENEFITS PACKAGE:**

* **Earn an additional week of paid time off including floating holidays, and personal time! Plus,**
* **13 paid holidays per year, and paid sick time!**
* **Company paid Life Insurance,**
* **Company paid Accidental Death & Dismemberment Insurance,**
* **401K,**
* **Opt-in benefits available: Pet Insurance, Employee/Spouse/Child Life Insurance, and Long Term Disability,**
* **Plus, Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance!**

 

**Organization Overview:**

Sound Community Services, Inc. (SCSI) is a private, not-for-profit organization dedicated to educating, assisting, and supporting individuals with persistent mental illness and substance use disorders. We work tirelessly to create a culture and environment in which recovery and wellness are possible.

**Position Overview:**

The Director of Quality Assurance (QA) oversees all agency activities related to quality improvement, compliance, data integrity, and regulatory preparedness for the agency. This position provides leadership in the development, implementation, and monitoring of systems that support clinical excellence, consumer rights, performance measurement, and regulatory compliance. The Director plays a critical role in the maintenance, configuration, and optimization of the Electronic Health Record (EHR); oversees required state reporting; maintains the centralized repository of all Department of Mental Health and Addiction Services (DMHAS) reported data; and ensures accurate and timely data submission. This role also leads the agency’s preparation for external audits (ex., Commission on Accreditation of Rehabilitation Facilities (CARF), Department of Public Health (DPH), DMHAS), coordinates customer satisfaction activities, and serves as the agency’s Client Rights Officer.

This position is responsible for the monitoring and analyzing of processes to meet Fidelity and contractual requirements across the agency. Ongoing analysis of health care information obtained from a variety of sources, including patient care, financial, and demographic data is necessary. This role involves the development and preparation of information for state reporting and organizational best practices. This position will maintain repository of all state reported data for all DMHAS programs. A heavy importance is placed on collaborating with program leaders across the agency, ensuring accuracy of data reported and driving agency performance.

**Essential Functions**

**Department Leadership, Training, and Support**

* Directly supervise two (2) employees in the Quality Assurance department and serve as backup to staff as needed.
* Provide Daily Living Activities Functional Assessment (DLA-20), program specific documentation, and recovery planning training to the agency.
* Train employees and monitor compliance across programs with state reporting requirements.
* Function as an internal information expert to the entire management team when special and critical quality issues occur.
* Consult with senior leadership to resolve quality, service, and efficiency problems.

**State Reporting, Data, and Surveys**

* Facilitate and coordinate annual DMHAS Consumer Satisfaction Surveys and quarterly CARF Satisfaction surveys.
* Provide DMHAS Data Performance System (DDaP) data and informational support to other departments, including DDaP 101 supervisor training, share DMHAS information with leadership, and present quarterly and annual DMHAS Report Cards to leadership.

**Electronic Health Record (EHR) and Systems Support**

* Triage QA tickets. Issues include, but are not limited to, document management, on/off-boarding, medical staff onboarding, system outages, etc.
* Facilitate within the EHR the build and support of procedures, forms, and form development; implement training to identified employees.
* Foster ongoing support to assigned programs and serve as a liaison between staff and vendors for effective responses to users’ needs.

**Audit Readiness, Compliance, and Quality Improvement**

* Provide support to programs in preparation for routine external audits, including CARF survey, fidelity reviews, and Department of Public Health licensing.
* Facilitate completion of all corrective action plans and audit follow-up, including quarterly and annual program compliance reviews.
* Monitor and assist with corrections and work with programs to identify and resolve root causes as needed.
* Ensure compliance with SCSI’s policies, quality assurance programs, and safety; ensure EHR compliance with regulatory agencies like DMHAS, DPH, CARF, etc.
* Participate in quality improvement initiatives.
* Serve as the agency’s Client Rights Officer (CRO), observing and adhering to the role outlined by DMHAS.

**Agency Participation and Policy Compliance**

* Participate in all agency activities pertaining to health and safety, training, drills, etc.
* Adhere to SCSI policies and procedures.

**Physical Requirements**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, use hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls, and climb stairs. The employee frequently is required to walk, talk and/or hear; speaking and hearing ability sufficient to communicate effectively by phone or in person at normal volumes; vision adequate to read correspondence, computer screen, forms, etc. The employee is occasionally required to stand and climb or balance. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 lbs. Specific vision abilities required by this position include the ability to adjust focus. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Strong understanding of Connecticut DMHAS standards, documentation requirements, and reporting systems (including DDaP).
* Demonstrated ability to supervise, lead, and coach staff.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and communicate findings clearly.
* Demonstrated technology and software application skills; ability to learn new software packages; highly skilled in office productivity software (e.g., Word, PowerPoint, Excel, email).
* Excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Ability to be proactive, flexible, and customer service focused and to work effectively with others.

**Qualifications**

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree required, or an equivalent combination of education and related experience.

**Minimum experience:** Experience working with electronic health record system, i.e., CareLogic; experience providing training; and experience with accreditation standards such as CARF, DMHAS, DPH, or similar regulatory bodies.

**Preferred qualifications:** Bachelor’s degree in Public Health, Social Work, Psychology, Healthcare Administration, or a related field. Masters degree preferred.

**Preferred license:** Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) or Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC)

**Driver’s license requirement:** A current valid driver’s license is required.

**Background check, credentialing, health screening, or other employment requirements:** Successful completion of required background checks and any other applicable agency employment requirements.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religious creed, age, sex, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, marital status, civil union status, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, present or past history of mental disability, intellectual disability, learning disability, physical disability, including but not limited to blindness, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, status as a victim of domestic violence, status as a victim of sexual assault, status as a victim of trafficking in persons, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

**Other Duties**

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by individuals assigned to this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Employees may be required to perform other job-related duties as assigned.

existing_roles.title: Senior Director, Quality Control
existing_roles.description:
ElevateBio is a technology-driven company powering the industry forward by helping partners realize the potential of their therapies from design to commercialization. We have integrated a differentiated set of technologies, end-to-end services, and industry-leading manufacturing expertise to develop advanced therapies faster and more efficiently.

 

**The Role**

The Senior Director, Quality Control leads all Quality Control operations at ElevateBio's Waltham site, including QC Analytical Technologies (QCAT), QC Analytics, Testing Core, QC Microbiology, QC Raw Materials, and QC Logistics. The role is accountable for safe, compliant, inspection-ready, and predictable execution across a seven-day operating model, including product release and in-process testing, STAT support to Manufacturing, environmental and microbiological testing, raw material disposition, stability support, sample management, and analytical lifecycle enablement. The Senior Director establishes the QC operating strategy, capacity and resource plan, performance system, and leadership model required to meet manufacturing, client, and business commitments while sustaining laboratory excellence and data integrity.

**Here's What You'll Do**

**QC Strategy and Leadership**

* Lead the integrated QC organization, operating model, objectives, decision rights, talent strategy, and capability roadmap.
* Develop QC management and technical leaders while aligning headcount, seven-day coverage, facilities, equipment, systems, operating expense, and capital with demand.

**Predictable QC Operations and Laboratory Excellence**

* Own safe, compliant, and predictable execution of product release and in-process testing, environmental and microbiological monitoring, raw material disposition, stability, sample management, and client commitments.
* Ensure reliable seven-day operations through capacity planning, schedule control, tiered daily management, performance review, and timely escalation and recovery.
* Partner with Manufacturing to align readiness, prioritization, and rapid execution of STAT in-process samples within required decision windows.
* Drive laboratory excellence through standard work, right-first-time execution, efficient review and reporting, backlog control, structured problem solving, and continuous improvement.

**Analytical Technologies and Lifecycle Enablement**

* Provide leadership oversight for QCAT, including client technical interface, technology and method transfer, qualification and validation, method lifecycle management, equipment qualification, controls and critical reagents, and Digital QC.

existing_roles.title: Director of Quality & Compliance
existing_roles.description:
**Reports to:** Executive Director

 

**Job Summary:**

The Director of Quality and Compliance for the PACE (Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly) Program will oversee and manage all aspects of quality assurance, compliance, and regulatory adherence for the PACE program. This role ensures that the program operates in full compliance with federal, state, and local regulations, as well as upholds the highest standards of care for the elderly participants. The Director will lead efforts to continuously improve program quality, enhance participant satisfaction, and drive performance excellence across the organization.

 

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Regulatory Compliance Management:

* Ensure adherence to all PACE-related federal, state, and local regulations, including CMS (Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services) and state-specific requirements.

* Monitor and interpret updates to regulatory policies, and adjust organizational practices as necessary to remain compliant.

* Act as the primary liaison between the organization and regulatory agencies, ensuring timely reporting and response to audits, surveys, and inspections.

2. Quality Assurance and Improvement:

* In collaboration with the Medical Director develop, implement, and evaluate quality improvement initiatives to ensure high standards of care, safety, and service delivery for participants.

* Collaborate with clinical and operational teams to analyze performance metrics and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

* Oversee the development and execution of corrective action plans (CAPs) for any areas of deficiency, ensuring timely resolution.

3. Risk Management and Reporting:

* Lead risk assessment processes to identify potential compliance and quality issues, minimizing risk to the organization and participants.

* Develop and implement risk mitigation strategies, including monitoring trends, identifying patterns, and taking proactive actions.

* Ensure the organization is prepared for external audits and inspections, managing all compliance-related documentation and reporting.

4. Staff Training and Development:

* Develop and conduct ongoing training programs for staff on compliance, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.

* Foster a culture of compliance and continuous improvement across the organization by leading educational initiatives and creating awareness.

* Provide guidance and support to staff on regulatory changes, quality standards, and best practices.

5. Participant Care and Satisfaction:

* Advocate for participants’ safety and satisfaction, ensuring that their rights and well-being are protected in all aspects of the program.

* Work closely with interdisciplinary teams to ensure person-centered care is at the core of all service delivery and interventions.

* Monitor and evaluate participant feedback, addressing any concerns or complaints in a timely and professional manner.

6. Leadership and Strategic Planning:

* Serve as a key member of the senior leadership team, contributing to the strategic direction of the PACE program.

* Collaborate with leadership to set annual goals for quality and compliance performance and develop strategies to achieve these objectives.

* Ensure alignment of quality and compliance initiatives with organizational goals and values.

7. Data Collection and Analysis:

* Oversee the collection, analysis, and reporting of quality and compliance data to track program performance and outcomes.

* Utilize data to drive decision-making and identify areas for operational improvements and resource allocation.

* Prepare reports and presentations for senior leadership and external stakeholders regarding compliance, quality, and performance metrics.

8. Technology and EMR

* Serving as the primary point of contact for EMR-related issues, providing guidance and troubleshooting support to team members.

* Leading training sessions and providing ongoing support for staff to ensure efficient use of the EMR system.

* Collaborating with IT and management teams to implement updates and resolve system issues.

* Continuously staying updated on new features and best practices for the EMR system to ensure the organization is utilizing the platform to its full potential.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, nursing, public health, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).

* Minimum of 4 years of experience in quality management, compliance, or regulatory affairs in a healthcare setting, with at least 2 years in a leadership role.

* Knowledge and experience with PACE program operations and regulations (CMS and state-level).

* Strong understanding of healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, and compliance protocols.

* Proven track record in leading quality improvement initiatives and risk management programs.

* Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.

* Ability to work collaboratively across departments and with interdisciplinary teams.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to drive results.

* Certification in Healthcare Quality (CHCQM, CPHQ) or other relevant certifications preferred.

**Physical Demands:**

* Ability to work in an office environment and attend in-person meetings.

* Occasional travel to program sites or regulatory meetings may be required.

**Work Environment:**

* A collaborative, team-oriented atmosphere within a dynamic, fast-paced healthcare environment.

* Commitment to participant-centered care and service excellence.

existing_roles.title: Head of Quality
existing_roles.description:
**About Tutor**

We believe robots should be the next chapter in making physical labor safer and more affordable. But, nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t have a single robot. Tutor Intelligence is changing that.

We build robots that go straight into real factories and warehouses, to do real work, with real impact. Our robot Cassie does back-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for family-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Our robot Sonny does handwork, using two arms to achieve human-like dexterity in picking and packing. Every robot learns on the job, and each one we deploy makes the next one more capable, more affordable, and faster to put to work.

Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, we do it all in-house: the robotics hardware, the machine learning, and the field deployment and service. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems.

Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world.

**Why Tutor?**

Whether you’re designing robots, closing deals, running deployments, or creating the processes that help us scale, your work doesn’t sit on a shelf. It shows up on real production floors, making physical work safer and more affordable.

Our team of 160+ is driven by curiosity and a genuine love of building. Everyone here takes real ownership, learns fast, and holds a high bar while having each other’s backs. If you love hard problems and creating things that didn’t exist before, you’ll fit right in.

**The Role**

Tutor is hiring a Head of Quality to lead quality as a function, alongside the Head of Manufacturing. You own the quality system, supplier quality across our supply base, product safety certifications, and the quality targets the company holds itself to. The quality engineers and the quality manager report to you, and you grow the team from there. You report to the CTO. As our operations organization grows, you and the Head of Manufacturing will report to the leader of that organization.

This is a building role. The first pieces, incoming inspection, supplier controls and failure analysis, are being put in place by the team you will lead. Your job is to turn them into a system that holds as production grows, a supplier base we can trust, and a quality record that customers and certifying bodies can verify. You have the authority to hold any shipment that is not right.

### **Requirements**

* You have led a quality function at a company that builds complex electromechanical hardware in volume
* You have built or rebuilt a quality system and taken it through ISO 9001 or an equivalent certification
* You have run supplier quality across a supply base, including suppliers overseas
* You have taken a product through product safety certification
* You have built and led a team of quality engineers and managers
* You make decisions from data, and you can hold a shipment when the data says so

### **Nice to haves**

* Robotics, automation, vehicles, or capital equipment
* Reliability engineering methods: life testing, failure rate analysis, design reviews
* Building quality data and tooling that other teams use
* Experience with manufacturing execution systems

### **Benefits**

* **Fully employer-covered health insurance**, so you’re protected without the premium.
* **A managed 401(k)** to help you plan for the future.
* **Generous time off:** unlimited PTO and all federal holidays off for full-time salaried employees, and 16+ days of accrued paid time off plus 1.5x pay on federal holidays for hourly employees.
* **Regular in-office meals** and team social events throughout the year.

**Compensation**

The base salary range for this role is $220,000 to $280,000, depending on experience.

As Tutor grows, so will our benefits. We’re continuing to invest in ways to support our team at work and beyond.

*Tutor Intelligence is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.*

existing_roles.title: Global Director of Quality
existing_roles.description:
**Lead Globally. Drive Innovation. Make an Impact.**

**Join Amphenol Alden and Make a Difference in Patient Care Worldwide!**

At **Amphenol Alden Products (AAP)**, what we do matters. Our medical cable assemblies and interconnect solutions support the advanced technologies healthcare professionals rely on every day. Behind every product is a patient, a family, and an opportunity to make a difference in someone's life.

With roots as a family business more than 90 years ago, Amphenol Alden combines a proud history and entrepreneurial spirit with the resources and opportunities of a global corporation. We are a growing organization that values innovation, teamwork, accountability, and the contributions of our employees.

We believe our people are the foundation of our success. That's why we offer competitive compensation, an outstanding benefits package, work/life balance, and opportunities for professional growth and development.

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking an experienced and strategic **Global Director of Quality** to lead and advance quality operations across four manufacturing facilities in the United States, Mexico, India, and China.

Reporting to AAP’s General Manager and serving as a member of the Leadership Team, this individual will establish and drive the global quality strategy, strengthen Quality Management Systems (QMS), and promote a culture of quality excellence and continuous improvement throughout the organization.

This is an opportunity to make a significant impact by developing high-performing global Quality teams, driving operational improvements, strengthening customer and supplier partnerships, and ensuring consistent quality standards across all manufacturing locations.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities**

* **Global Quality Strategy:** Develop and execute global quality strategies, objectives, and initiatives that support business goals, product quality, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence.
* **Quality Management Systems:** Lead the development, implementation, standardization, and continuous improvement of Quality Management Systems across all facilities, ensuring compliance with ISO 9001, ISO 13485, applicable FDA requirements, customer specifications, and other relevant regulatory standards.
* **Executive Leadership:** Participate as a member of the Executive Leadership Team in establishing business strategies, operational objectives, and organizational improvement initiatives.
* **Quality Performance:** Establish and monitor global quality metrics, including customer complaints, internal and supplier defects, Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ), corrective actions, and audit performance. Drive measurable improvements in quality and process capability.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Champion Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and data-driven problem-solving methodologies to reduce defects, minimize waste, improve process consistency, and enhance overall operational performance.
* **Engineering and Operations Partnership:** Collaborate with Engineering and Operations to ensure effective quality planning, design and process FMEAs, risk assessments, process validation, and verification throughout the product lifecycle.
* **New Product Introduction:** Provide quality leadership for New Product Introduction (NPI) and manufacturing transfers, ensuring process capability, quality requirements, and customer expectations are met before production release.
* **Supplier Quality:** Partner with Global Supply Chain to develop and maintain a high-performing supplier base through supplier qualification, audits, performance monitoring, development, and corrective action programs.
* **Customer Quality:** Provide strategic leadership for customer quality initiatives, serving as the senior escalation point for significant quality concerns, customer audits, and corrective action resolution.
* **Audits and Regulatory Compliance:** Oversee internal and external quality audits, regulatory inspections, and management reviews, ensuring findings are addressed promptly and compliance is sustained.
* **Corrective and Preventive Action:** Strengthen global CAPA processes through effective root cause analysis, risk mitigation, and prevention of recurring quality issues.
* **Global Team Leadership:** Lead, mentor, and develop the global Quality organization, establishing clear expectations, accountability, talent development plans, and succession strategies.
* **Global Standardization:** Promote consistency and the sharing of best practices across manufacturing facilities in the United States, Mexico, India, and China.
* **Executive Reporting:** Provide regular updates to executive leadership on global quality performance, emerging risks, customer satisfaction, and progress toward strategic quality objectives.

**Related Experience and Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Quality, Engineering, or a related technical or scientific discipline; Master's degree preferred.
* 10+ years of previous related experience and at least 5 years of experience managing individuals.
* Strong knowledge of ISO 13485, ISO 9001, FDA Quality System requirements, and applicable regulatory standards.
* Demonstrated experience leading Quality Management Systems and continuous improvement initiatives across multiple manufacturing locations.
* Strong working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, CAPA, root cause analysis, risk management, and quality improvement methodologies.
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams, develop talent, and drive results in a global organization.

**Why Join Amphenol Alden?**

We believe great people deserve a great place to work. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your professional success, financial future, and overall well-being.

* Competitive salary and bonus opportunity.
* Hybrid work schedule.
* Excellent 401(k) retirement savings plan to help you plan for the future.
* Comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short- and long-term disability, Health Savings Account (HSA), and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA).
* Employee discounts and company-sponsored activities.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career development.
* The opportunity to lead a global organization and make a meaningful contribution to products that support patient care worldwide.

**Ready to Lead What's Next?**

If you are a strategic quality leader who thrives on building strong teams, solving complex challenges, and driving results across global operations, we'd love to hear from you!

**Join Amphenol Alden and help shape the future of our global operations while making a difference in patient care around the world.**

*Amphenol Alden Products is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

*Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.*

existing_roles.description:
**Company Overview**

Contentnea Health is a Community Health Center providing comprehensive medical, dental and behavioral health services for members of our communities in Greene, Pitt and Pamlico counties in eastern North Carolina.

**Job Summary**

Provides strategic leadership, oversight, and coordination of all organizational quality initiatives, including designing, implementing and evaluating quality programs to ensure delivery of safe, patient-centered, equitable, and efficient care, leads data-driven improvement efforts, and supports regulatory reporting and compliance with standards.

**Responsibilities and Duties**

* Oversees the Quality Improvement (QI) department activities.
 + Leads the development, implementation, and evaluation of the organization’s Quality Improvement Program.
 + Identifies opportunities to support QI efforts through evaluation, testing, and/or integration for electronic health record (EHR) functionality and other Heath Information and Technology (HIT) systems.
 + Summarizes and shares clinical quality data with the Board, key leadership, and staff to inform decision-making and priorities for improvement.
 + Champions the adoption of standardized best practices and lessons learned across disciplines and departments at the care team level and at the organizational level using communication tools, published workflows, staff meetings, events and trainings.
 + Facilitates QI Committee meetings and ensures documentation, follow-up, and progress tracking.
 + Establishes annual QI goals, work plans, and performance benchmarks aligned with strategic priorities.
 + Develops dashboards and data tools to share performance results with leadership and staff.
* Collaborates with and guides clinical care team members to establish QI processes through the organization.
 + Leads or participates in work teams related to QI and functions as a coach to support care team in building, fostering patient-centeredness and healthy patient outcomes.
 + Researches external organizations and participates in training opportunities, and works with partners, consultants and experts to guide QI efforts.
 + Assesses the need for and facilitates education, training, and technical assistance for staff to ensure compliance with QI efforts.
 + Uses existing data systems to identify areas in need of quality improvement across the organization.
* Oversees organizational data submission and sharing to external entities in collaboration with other departments as needed.
 + Follows regulation on data collection and reporting structure as defined by the Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA) and health plan incentives.
 + Approaches changes to the EHR or other IT systems with consideration to data governance.
 + Monitors Federal Tort Claims Act (FTCA) requirements and the health center’s compliance.
 + Leads the annual FTCA deeming and redeeming application process and ensures all required evidence and documentation are completed and submitted accurately.
 + Ensures accurate and timely reporting of UDS clinical measures and other federal/state quality requirements.
 + Participates in HRSA review and response with organization leaders.
 + Acts as administrator for electronic Value-Based Care (VBC) and Quality Incentive Plans (QIP) platforms.
 + Partners with key leadership to determine participation priorities.
 + Oversees QI and clinical participation in contracted VBC and QIPs.
 + Monitors performance with VBC and incentive plans; shares performance data with key leadership.
* Ensures ongoing alignment with Patient-Centered Medical Home (PCMH) standards, manages The National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) reporting and serves as PCMH project manager.
 + Leads annual submission of PCMH report to maintain recognition for each recognized site and maintains documentation and policies needed for audits, accreditation, and regulatory compliance.
 + Ensures all new hires are trained in PCMH processes, policies, and workflows, including care coordination, team-based care, access, patient experience and satisfaction.
 + Maintains current knowledge of NCQA/PCMH standards and serves as the subject matter expert. Analyzes and reviews processes, policies, and systems on an ongoing basis to ensure they are aligned with current and updated PCMH standards.
 + Uses data to drive continuous improvement in clinical quality, patient experience and cost/utilization outcomes.
 + Reports PCMH performance to leadership to inform resource allocation and prioritize performance improvement activities.
 + Coordinates PCMH improvement activities with staff and leadership.
* Provides overall management and direction to departmental staff.
 + Oversees the development and maintenance of the departmental budget; monitors ongoing budgetary compliance and addresses problems as needed.
 + Delegates departmental duties and responsibilities; participates in high priority special projects and activities.
 + Represents the department at all senior management meetings.
 + Prepares departmental company policies and procedures and conveys all senior management communications and directives.
 + Monitors departmental performance using company performance standards and addresses issues as needed.
 + Directs departmental performance and provides specific instructions on completion of tasks/responsibilities.
 + Prepares and conducts performance appraisals for immediate staff.
 + Conducts hiring, disciplinary, and termination procedures.

**Qualifications and Skills**

Bachelor Degree in Nursing. Current licensure as a Registered Nurse in good standing with the NC Board of Nursing. Possesses advanced understanding of quality improvement theory and quality methodology, evidence-based practice, state and national priorities for patient safety and population health as determined by HRSA, DHHS, and other entities, and regulatory, recognition and compliance standards, such as FTCA, PCMH, and HRSA. The ideal candidate will have progressive experience in leading quality improvement activities and in leading staff.

existing_roles.title: Quality Director
existing_roles.description:
Description:

Exalt Health, an acute rehabilitation hospital, provides an intensive rehabilitation program, and admitted patients must be able to tolerate three hours of intense rehabilitation services per day. Focused on caring for patients with complex rehabilitative needs such as stroke, spinal cord injury, brain injury, head trauma, medically debilitation conditions, neurological disorders, cardio-pulmonary amputations, orthopedic injuries, and multiple major traumas.

**Position Summary**

The Quality Director is responsible for spearheading the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of a comprehensive quality and patient safety program throughout our inpatient rehabilitation hospital network. In this role, you will drive a culture of excellence, ensuring our delivery of the highest standards of patient care across all our facilities in Texas. This position demands strong leadership, data analysis skills, exceptional attention to detail, and an unwavering commitment to patient-centered care.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Strategic Planning: Design and implement a system-wide quality management framework, aligning with organizational goals and regulatory requirements.
* Performance Monitoring: Oversee the collection, analysis, and reporting of key quality metrics and patient outcome data. Identify trends, pinpoint areas for improvement, and develop targeted interventions.
* Continuous Improvement: Lead initiatives to enhance clinical quality, patient safety, and process efficiency across all rehabilitation facilities. Implement evidence-based best practices and drive innovation in quality improvement endeavors.
* Regulatory Compliance: Ensure adherence to all state, federal, and accreditation standards (e.g., The Joint Commission) related to quality management and patient safety.
* Education and Training: Develop and deliver educational programs to cultivate a quality-focused culture among staff at all levels.
* Collaboration: Partner with clinical leaders, department heads, and frontline staff to foster a collaborative environment focused on continuous improvement and patient satisfaction.
* Risk Management: Proactively identify and mitigate potential risks to patient safety and guide the organization in proactive risk management practices.
* Board Reporting: Prepare regular reports for the Executive Leadership team and Board of Directors, showcasing quality performance metrics, initiatives, and strategic recommendations.

Requirements:

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

Licenses or Certifications

* Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ) or other relevant quality certifications highly desired.
* Current, unencumbered clinical licenses in the state where the hospital is operating required.

Education, Training, and Experience

* Education in a healthcare-related field or a clinical degree preferred.
* Minimum of 7-10 years of progressive leadership experience in healthcare quality management, with a proven track record in an inpatient hospital setting.

Skills and Abilities, Proficiency and Productivity Standards

* Deep knowledge of quality improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, PDSA).
* Expertise in healthcare regulatory standards, accreditation requirements, and best practices.
* Proficiency in healthcare data management and statistical analysis tools.
* Organizes and prioritizes tasks and projects, accurately completing job responsibilities within the specified time constraints.
* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
* Analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work under deadlines and handle multiple tasks.
* Speaks and communicates English effectively in verbal and written format; writes legibly.
* Reading and comprehension at the level necessary to perform job duties appropriately.
* Works cooperatively with co-workers and other hospital employees
* Functions proficiently in a Microsoft Windows environment (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

The company is an equal opportunity employer, drug-free workplace, and complies with ADA regulations as applicable.
