protected_roles.description:
**Lead Globally. Drive Innovation. Make an Impact.**

**Join Amphenol Alden and Make a Difference in Patient Care Worldwide!**

At **Amphenol Alden Products (AAP)**, what we do matters. Our medical cable assemblies and interconnect solutions support the advanced technologies healthcare professionals rely on every day. Behind every product is a patient, a family, and an opportunity to make a difference in someone's life.

With roots as a family business more than 90 years ago, Amphenol Alden combines a proud history and entrepreneurial spirit with the resources and opportunities of a global corporation. We are a growing organization that values innovation, teamwork, accountability, and the contributions of our employees.

We believe our people are the foundation of our success. That's why we offer competitive compensation, an outstanding benefits package, work/life balance, and opportunities for professional growth and development.

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking an experienced and strategic **Global Director of Quality** to lead and advance quality operations across four manufacturing facilities in the United States, Mexico, India, and China.

Reporting to AAP’s General Manager and serving as a member of the Leadership Team, this individual will establish and drive the global quality strategy, strengthen Quality Management Systems (QMS), and promote a culture of quality excellence and continuous improvement throughout the organization.

This is an opportunity to make a significant impact by developing high-performing global Quality teams, driving operational improvements, strengthening customer and supplier partnerships, and ensuring consistent quality standards across all manufacturing locations.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities**

* **Global Quality Strategy:** Develop and execute global quality strategies, objectives, and initiatives that support business goals, product quality, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence.
* **Quality Management Systems:** Lead the development, implementation, standardization, and continuous improvement of Quality Management Systems across all facilities, ensuring compliance with ISO 9001, ISO 13485, applicable FDA requirements, customer specifications, and other relevant regulatory standards.
* **Executive Leadership:** Participate as a member of the Executive Leadership Team in establishing business strategies, operational objectives, and organizational improvement initiatives.
* **Quality Performance:** Establish and monitor global quality metrics, including customer complaints, internal and supplier defects, Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ), corrective actions, and audit performance. Drive measurable improvements in quality and process capability.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Champion Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and data-driven problem-solving methodologies to reduce defects, minimize waste, improve process consistency, and enhance overall operational performance.
* **Engineering and Operations Partnership:** Collaborate with Engineering and Operations to ensure effective quality planning, design and process FMEAs, risk assessments, process validation, and verification throughout the product lifecycle.
* **New Product Introduction:** Provide quality leadership for New Product Introduction (NPI) and manufacturing transfers, ensuring process capability, quality requirements, and customer expectations are met before production release.
* **Supplier Quality:** Partner with Global Supply Chain to develop and maintain a high-performing supplier base through supplier qualification, audits, performance monitoring, development, and corrective action programs.
* **Customer Quality:** Provide strategic leadership for customer quality initiatives, serving as the senior escalation point for significant quality concerns, customer audits, and corrective action resolution.
* **Audits and Regulatory Compliance:** Oversee internal and external quality audits, regulatory inspections, and management reviews, ensuring findings are addressed promptly and compliance is sustained.
* **Corrective and Preventive Action:** Strengthen global CAPA processes through effective root cause analysis, risk mitigation, and prevention of recurring quality issues.
* **Global Team Leadership:** Lead, mentor, and develop the global Quality organization, establishing clear expectations, accountability, talent development plans, and succession strategies.
* **Global Standardization:** Promote consistency and the sharing of best practices across manufacturing facilities in the United States, Mexico, India, and China.
* **Executive Reporting:** Provide regular updates to executive leadership on global quality performance, emerging risks, customer satisfaction, and progress toward strategic quality objectives.

**Related Experience and Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Quality, Engineering, or a related technical or scientific discipline; Master's degree preferred.
* 10+ years of previous related experience and at least 5 years of experience managing individuals.
* Strong knowledge of ISO 13485, ISO 9001, FDA Quality System requirements, and applicable regulatory standards.
* Demonstrated experience leading Quality Management Systems and continuous improvement initiatives across multiple manufacturing locations.
* Strong working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, CAPA, root cause analysis, risk management, and quality improvement methodologies.
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams, develop talent, and drive results in a global organization.

**Why Join Amphenol Alden?**

We believe great people deserve a great place to work. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your professional success, financial future, and overall well-being.

* Competitive salary and bonus opportunity.
* Hybrid work schedule.
* Excellent 401(k) retirement savings plan to help you plan for the future.
* Comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short- and long-term disability, Health Savings Account (HSA), and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA).
* Employee discounts and company-sponsored activities.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career development.
* The opportunity to lead a global organization and make a meaningful contribution to products that support patient care worldwide.

**Ready to Lead What's Next?**

If you are a strategic quality leader who thrives on building strong teams, solving complex challenges, and driving results across global operations, we'd love to hear from you!

**Join Amphenol Alden and help shape the future of our global operations while making a difference in patient care around the world.**

*Amphenol Alden Products is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

*Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.*

**Company Overview**

Contentnea Health is a Community Health Center providing comprehensive medical, dental and behavioral health services for members of our communities in Greene, Pitt and Pamlico counties in eastern North Carolina.

**Job Summary**

Provides strategic leadership, oversight, and coordination of all organizational quality initiatives, including designing, implementing and evaluating quality programs to ensure delivery of safe, patient-centered, equitable, and efficient care, leads data-driven improvement efforts, and supports regulatory reporting and compliance with standards.

**Responsibilities and Duties**

* Oversees the Quality Improvement (QI) department activities.
 + Leads the development, implementation, and evaluation of the organization’s Quality Improvement Program.
 + Identifies opportunities to support QI efforts through evaluation, testing, and/or integration for electronic health record (EHR) functionality and other Heath Information and Technology (HIT) systems.

protected_roles.title: Quality Assurance Director
protected_roles.description:
Arrowhead Winch engineers and manufactures industrial winch, hoist and drive systems under the BRADEN, CARCO and Gearmatic brand names in Broken Arrow and Okmulgee, Oklahoma. We are seeking a talented **Quality Assurance Director** to join our team in **Broken Arrow, Oklahoma.** Please note: This is a **100% on site** office-based position supporting both the Okmulgee and Broken Arrow, Oklahoma manufacturing plants. Benefits include 401K with matching up to 5%, plus profit sharing plan; medical, dental and vision plans; flexible spending and health savings accounts; paid short- and long-term disability program; paid life insurance; and paid holidays, sick and vacation time. Our work environments are clean, climate controlled and safe. Arrowhead Winch does require applicants to complete a background check, drug test, and pre-employment physical as a condition of employment. Our goal is for all employees to work safely without injury while maintaining the highest safety standards in compliance with company policies.

**Quality Assurance Director** **Position Overview:**

The Quality Assurance Director leads the Quality Department and builds a world-class, prevention-focused quality culture across the Broken Arrow and Okmulgee plants. Partnering with Operations, Engineering, Purchasing, and frontline teams, this leader promotes quality at the source, shared accountability, and measurable customer satisfaction. The role oversees the ISO 9001 Quality Management System (QMS), customer and supplier quality, corrective action, measurement systems, traceability, warranty analysis, and new-product readiness.

**Quality Assurance Director** **Essential Functions/Responsibilities:**

* Build a quality-at-the-source culture through visible shop-floor leadership, employee engagement, supervisor coaching, recognition, and shared accountability.
* Set quality strategy and annual goals aligned with business priorities, customer requirements, and measurable results.
* Lead and standardize quality procedures, controls, audits, and ISO 9001 management reviews across both plants; ensure actions are completed and effective.
* Partner with Operations to strengthen standard work, in-process checks, visual controls, and mistake-proofing to prevent defects and improve first-pass yield.
* Establish clear expectations for employees to identify, contain, and escalate suspect product; support prompt action on quality concerns.
* Define quality standards and process controls for machining, welding, painting, assembly, and final testing.
* Track and review leading and lagging quality measures, including first-pass yield, customer escapes, scrap, rework, warranty cost, supplier rejects, cost of poor quality, and corrective-action effectiveness; assign owners for improvements.
* Monitor customer scorecards and ensure customer-specific specifications, certifications, inspection records, and corrective-action requirements are met at both plants.
* Communicate quality issues, containment plans, corrective actions, and verified closure promptly and accurately to customers.
* Develop employee quality awareness and problem-solving skills; maintain inspector training, qualification, and competency requirements.
* Lead Quality Department staffing, coaching, performance management, succession planning, and professional development.
* Oversee calibration, measurement system suitability, and gage repeatability and reproducibility (Gage R&R) studies.
* Lead cross-functional root-cause analysis and corrective action using structured methods such as 8D or 5 Whys; verify actions prevent recurrence.
* Use risk-based and layered process audits to confirm compliance with critical controls and sustain improvements.
* Manage nonconforming material, including identification, containment, segregation, documented disposition, controlled deviations, and release authorization.
* Control process changes through risk assessment, approval, validation, documentation, and communication.
* Partner with Purchasing to improve supplier quality through scorecards, reject trends, audits or visits, and targeted corrective actions.
* Lead returned-product, warranty, and field-failure investigations; coordinate containment, customer feedback, and prevention of repeat issues.
* Partner with Design Engineering to improve manufacturability and eliminate design-related quality risks.
* Support new products, engineering changes, and process transfers through risk-based quality planning, PFMEAs, control plans, inspections, and process validation.
* Set end-of-line testing requirements and records; ensure failed tests are investigated and authorized before retest or product release.
* Maintain part, component, production, and test traceability appropriate to product and customer requirements.
* Manage the quality budget and prioritize sustainable improvements that reduce the cost of poor quality without compromising conformance.
* Manage customer specific process approvals, create qualification plans, and maintain required test results and certifications. Establish required internal processes that must be maintained to hold the customer certifications.

**Quality Assurance Director** **Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, quality, manufacturing, or a related field.
* Seven to ten years of quality leadership in ISO 9001 manufacturing, including machining and assembly, multi-site supervision, and team development.
* Proven success building a quality-first culture, coaching frontline teams, and reducing recurring defects through prevention and accountability.
* Ability to interpret part and assembly drawings; working knowledge of metrology and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T).
* Practical experience with Lean/Six Sigma, structured root-cause analysis, and corrective-action effectiveness verification.
* Experience with statistical process control (SPC), Gage R&R, process capability, PFMEA, and control plans, including methods suited to low-volume, high-mix production.
* Strong analytical, technical, leadership, communication, and conflict-resolution skills; ability to influence cross-functional teams and work effectively with customers.
* Strong documentation and organizational skills; proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.

**Quality Assurance Director** **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Lean or Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or Black Belt preferred).
* ISO 9001 Lead Auditor training or certification.
* Experience using short-run SPC, layered process audits, and mistake-proofing in low-volume, high-mix manufacturing.
* Welding inspection knowledge; AWS Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) a plus.
* Knowledge of paint and coatings inspection.
* Knowledge and Experience using AI Tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Microsoft Copilot

**Physical Demands and Work Environment:**

* Sit, stand, and walk for extended periods, including in a manufacturing shop.
* Use a computer and review technical documents for extended periods.
* Have adequate vision to inspect parts and review documents.
* Hear and speak clearly for effective communication.
* Occasionally lift up to 50 lbs. with assistance and bend, squat, or stoop.
* Work around electrical and heavy equipment; handle and inspect parts.
* Wear required personal protective equipment (PPE) in applicable areas.
* Travel regularly between the Broken Arrow and Okmulgee plants.

If accommodation required, contact HR at 918-259-3259.

protected_roles.title: Director of Quality & Food Safety
protected_roles.description:
**Summary:** Lead the company’s food safety, quality assurance, laboratory, and regulatory compliance programs. Establishes and maintains effective systems that protect consumers, meet customer and certification requirements, and support consistent manufacturing of safe, high-quality popcorn products.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

**Food Safety & Compliance**

* Direct the BRCGS food safety certification program, HACCP plans, & FSMA compliance activities
* Maintain & improve food safety plans, SOPs, SSOPs, records, training, verification activities, and audit readiness
* Help lead internal, customer, regulatory, and certification audits; oversee corrective actions and timely closure of findings
* Maintain product and ingredient specifications, quality databases, ERP traceability, and recall-readiness procedures, develop production BOMs in an ERP program, support production planning systems

**Quality Assurance & Lab**

* Lead the Quality Supervisor and Product Development Specialist; establish priorities, training, performance, expectations, and accountability
* Oversee lab equipment, supplies, maintenance and methods, including peroxide value, oil color, moisture, salt, allergen, microbiological, and popping-performance testing as well as QC related production equipment
* Provide quality assessment of slurry process deviations and misbatches; coordinate corrective formula decisions with Product Development & Production
* Oversee sampling, analytical and microbiological testing, shelf-life studies, calibration, and reliable reporting of results
* Track quality metrics, identify trends, and drive preventive and corrective improvements with operations
* Calculate Nutritional Profiles
* Develop FDA compliant Ingredient Statements

**Supplier, Sanitation, & Allergen Programs**

* Manage supplier and raw-material qualification, specifications, receiving/testing standards, and supplier corrective actions for ingredients, packaging, and co-manufacturers
* Maintain allergen controls and the allergen matrix, partner with sanitation leadership on environmental monitoring and sanitation validation, including CIP and warewashing as applicable
* Coordinate on ingredient and packaging supplier issues, including flavors and microwave popcorn bags
* Additional Food Safety & Quality Program responsibility

**Regulatory, Customer, & Incident Response**

* Review ingredient declarations, allergen statements, labeling compliance, product claims, and export requirements in collaboration with Marketing & Product Development
* Maintain applicable kosher, halal, gluten-free, and other customer or product certifications
* Investigate complaints, nonconforming product and food safety incidents; direct holds, disposition decisions, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions within company authority
* Maintain customer quality documentation and retailer portals, communicate food safety risks promptly to leadership
* Food regulatory resource for all FDA changes, including labeling for US, Canada, & International

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Partner with Product Development on safe product introductions, specifications, allergen review, and manufacturing handoffs
* Build a proactive food safety culture through coaching, floor presence and cross-functional training
* And all other duties as assigned by Supervisor

**Qualifications:**

To perform this job successfully an individual must have the following: Strong leadership skills and a proven track record of effectively leading teams and managing people. A bachelor’s degree in food science, microbiology, chemistry, or related discipline required. Significant progressive experience in food manufacturing quality assurance and food safety, including people leadership. Hands on HACCP, FSMA/PCQI, and GFSI-recognized certification program experience; BRCGS preferred. Experience managing a quality lab, supplier quality, investigation, and audits. Experience with shelf-stable snack, fats/oils, or microwave product experience is a plus, but not required. International labeling and kosher/halal experience preferred. ERP, SPC, Power BI, Excel and quality reporting tool experience a plus.

**Skills and Competencies:**

This role will provide strong leadership to employees, fostering a positive and high-performing culture. Must possess the ability to set clear expectations while helping guide department supervisors. Must work to identify and minimize risks that could impact the company while ensuring safety compliance. Ensures we are staying compliant with legal and regulatory requirements while upholding high standards and ethical conduct throughout the organization. Must have excellent communication skills to engage with all levels of employees at all locations while encouraging collaboration across. Sound decision-making ability skill needed to prioritize initiatives, assess risks, and make decisions that align with the organization. Deep understanding of the technical aspects related to APCC products. Strong problem solving skills needed to address quality issues promptly and effectively. Analytical skills required to analyze data, processes, and systems to identify areas for improvement.

**Work Environment:**

The work environment is both an office setting at a manufacturing facility and in the manufacturing facility itself. The environment is often dynamic and collaborative, with collaboration being essential in this role. Employees will contribute to overall production goals, with office employees supporting the efficiency and effectiveness of the manufacturing processes. The manufacturing facility involves hands-on tasks, machinery operation, and adherence to GMPs. This setting requires attention to detail, adherence to protocols, and the ability to adapt to the demands of the production schedule. Working hours outside of standard office hours may be required.

**Physical Demands:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential responsibilities of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

This position requires a combination of sitting and standing throughout the workday. You will need to regularly engage in tasks that involve sitting at a desk for data entry and analysis, as well as administrative duties. You will also need to engage in tasks that require periods of standing, mobility and interaction with team members. This role requires adaptability to the changing demands of tasks and responsibilities. May be occasional lifting of supplies, typically not exceeding 20 pounds.

**General:**

At American Pop Corn Company, our culture is built on our TACT values – Teamwork, Always Learning, Customer First, & Tenacious. We are committed to creating a workplace where employees treat one another with respect, communicate openly, and work collaboratively toward shared goals.

Every employee plays an important role in our success. We are expected to support one another, remain adaptable, and step in when needed to help teammates or serve our customers. Employees are responsible for maintaining our high standards of safety, quality, and sanitation while identifying opportunities to solve problems, improve processes, and increase efficiency. By embracing our continuous learning, taking ownership of our work, and consistently putting our customers first, we strengthen our team and contribute to the long term success of the Company.

**What about benefits?** 
American Pop Corn Company has an amazing benefits package! Here are just some of our great benefits:

* FREE family health and dental insurance. That's right - JOLLY TIME doesn't charge for these benefits - and it's a major medical plan with full coverage!
* Vision insurance
* 401(k) with a 4% match
* 6 paid holidays
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Referral Bonus
* & More!

protected_roles.title: VP of Operations
protected_roles.description:
**VP of Operations**

TekConcierge | Richardson, TX (moving to Denton, TX in 2027) | Hybrid | Full-Time

*Maintenance is a myth. Every company is moving forward or backward. There is no neutral gear. At TekConcierge, we’ve chosen forward, and we’re looking for the operator who will build the engine that gets us there.*

**About TekConcierge**

For 16 years, TekConcierge has been the trusted technology partner for businesses across more than 15 industries, including private equity, family offices, RIAs and financial services, oil and gas, manufacturing, automotive, accounting, and hospitality. We deliver managed IT, cybersecurity, and compliance services, including CMMC and DFARS for defense contractors, to organizations that can’t afford downtime or risk.

Today we’re a ~55-person, $12M+ company. We have a clear plan to reach $50M in the next five years and $100M within ten, driven by organic growth, a major investment in marketing, and acquiring IT companies that fit our culture and strategy.

We don’t chase growth for ego. We see growth as stewardship. It builds a financial fortress that protects our team, equips our people for an AI-driven future, and elevates careers so no one has to leave TekConcierge to grow. We call it our Growth Covenant: **Protect · Equip · Elevate.**

We measure success in three words: **Grow · Give · Win.** Profit isn’t the finish line; it’s fuel for generosity, profit participation, investment in our people, and Kingdom-impact giving. We are a faith-driven, servant-led company. We use EOS as our operating guardrails, and we’re adopting The Great Game of Business so every team member understands the scoreboard and shares in the wins.

**The Role**

The VP of Operations owns the end-to-end operating system that turns what we sell into predictable, profitable, measurable client delivery. Reporting to the CEO, you’ll lead the managers of a 25–30 person organization across:

* Service Desk / NOC

* Field & Onsite Technicians

* Projects, Onboarding & Client Transitions

* Procurement

As TekConcierge grows, the role may take on additional company-wide responsibilities. You’ll partner closely with our Chief Growth Officer, CFO, Sales leadership, Technical Operations Lead, and CISO. Your job is to own the seams: the handoffs between Sales, onboarding, projects, and day-to-day support where client experience is won or lost. Functional leaders keep their expertise and authority; you make sure the whole system delivers.

**Authority to lead:** You’ll have the executive sponsorship and decision rights to establish the delivery operating model, lead the responsible managers, recommend organizational changes, enforce readiness standards, and hold cross-functional owners accountable for agreed commitments.

**This is not a turnaround.** You’ll inherit an established company, experienced functional leaders, recurring clients, mature MSP platforms, and an executive team committed to investing in operations. The next stage of growth needs a more scalable operating model. You’ll build it.

**Strategic and Hands-On**

You think strategically and stay close to the work. You can open a ticket, see how the technician solved it, and coach a faster, first-time fix. Success means strong managers and an operating rhythm that runs without executive rescue.

**Your First 90 Days**

* **Days 1–30, Baseline:** Map the delivery lifecycle, review performance and capacity, and define the first operational scorecard.

* **Days 31–60, Control:** Launch weekly delivery reviews, put readiness gates on new projects and onboardings, and create one view of active work, risks, and capacity.

* **Days 61–90, Scale:** Publish the delivery lifecycle, forecast capacity against the sales pipeline, start root-cause reviews on reopened tickets, and present a 12-month roadmap.

**Your First 12 Months**

1. **Standardize how we work.** Build one documented delivery lifecycle from signed agreement to steady-state support, with SOPs and playbooks in Autotask and IT Glue. Put ITIL-aligned practices and formal change management controls in place so improvements stick.

2. **Build operations that scale.** Design the structure, capacity planning, and systems that absorb rapid organic growth and future acquisitions without sacrificing service quality.

3. **Build the bench and reshape the Service Desk.** Develop and promote future managers, strengthen accountability, and partner with Service Desk leadership to redesign the model, including a potential move to pods.

**What You’ll Own**

* **End-to-end delivery:** Clear stage gates, owners, and handoffs from signed agreement through onboarding, projects, and support, with operational readiness and capacity validated before commitments are made.

* **The operational scorecard:** SLA attainment, response and resolution, backlog aging, first-time fix, reopen and escalation rates, and CSAT, reviewed weekly and driven relentlessly.

* **Quality and root cause:** Review tickets and reopens, lead root-cause reviews on recurring issues and client-impacting failures, and turn lessons into coaching, documentation, and better process.

* **Projects and onboarding:** Sold vs. actual hours, scope changes, and clean handoffs, so projects land on time and profitably.

* **Capacity and workforce:** A rolling capacity forecast that combines support demand, projects, onboarding, and growth, translated into hiring, training, and automation plans.

* **Financial performance:** Partner with the CFO on budgets and forecasts, and own the operating drivers: gross margin by service line, labor efficiency, utilization, effective hourly rate, project profitability, and vendor costs.

* **Client retention:** Connect operational performance to client health and renewal risk.

* **Acquisition integration:** Support operational due diligence and lead the integration of acquired companies’ people, clients, tools, and processes.

* **AI and automation:** Use our PSA, RMM, automation, and AI to grow output faster than headcount.

* **Compliance in practice:** Partner with the CISO to embed SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, and CMMC into daily delivery.

* **Leadership and culture:** Run the operating rhythm, model our core values, and teach every team member how the business wins.

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years of senior operations leadership (Director, VP, or COO level) running a complex, SLA-driven, recurring-service organization. MSP, IT, or cybersecurity services experience is strongly preferred; exceptional operators from hospitality, field services, or telecom are also welcome.

* Accountability for service delivery, project delivery, and client onboarding, leading managers and technical teams of 25+.

* Proven financial accountability: you’ve built budgets and forecasts and driven gross margin, labor efficiency, and profitability.

* A track record of building processes, operational controls, change management, and scorecards where few existed.

* Working knowledge of PSA and RMM environments and the data it takes to run an MSP.

* A strong technical foundation: your skills are sharp enough to review a ticket and coach a better solution.

* Experience leading large-scale projects and automation initiatives, and supporting regulated or audit-sensitive clients.

* You connect work across departments while respecting functional ownership.

* Genuine alignment with our core values and servant-leadership culture.

* Bachelor’s degree in business, operations, IT, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Bonus Points**

* Autotask and IT Glue (or ConnectWise, HaloPSA, Kaseya, or Datto)

* ITIL 4; PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or Prosci

* Leading in a SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 environment; NIST CSF, CIS Controls, CMMC, or DFARS

* Integrating an acquisition or major client transition; pod-based service delivery

* Applying AI to service operations, quality review, and knowledge management

* EOS, The Great Game of Business, or open-book management

We care more about demonstrated results than a perfect résumé. If you’ve built disciplined service operations, developed strong managers, and improved client and financial outcomes, apply even if you don’t check every box.

**Our Core Values**

* **Authentic:** We’re honest, genuine, and empathetic.

* **Professional:** We’re self-motivated, reliable, hardworking, proficient, and trustworthy team players. We’re winners, and we never stop learning.

* **Help First:** We help the client first, and the money follows. We follow through, do whatever it takes, and bring a high level of commitment, organization, and communication to every relationship.

* **Solutions-Focused:** We’re tenacious. We get things done. We solve business problems through technology.

**What We Offer**

* Executive-level base salary plus annual performance incentive

* Long-term incentive eligibility for the right leader

* A seat at the leadership table of a company in a deliberate growth and acquisition phase

* An open-book culture where wins are shared and celebrated together

* Paid vacation, health insurance, dental, and 401(k)

**Location and Expectations**

Hybrid, based at our Richardson, TX office with 3–4 days per week onsite. This is a North Texas role, not a fully remote position. Our office relocates to Denton, TX in 2027, so North DFW is ideal. Expect occasional travel to client sites and participation in executive escalations for major incidents (not a replacement for our on-call structure).

**How to Apply**

Submit your resume along with a short note (under 200 words) answering this question:

***“Tell us about a time you built or rebuilt an operation to scale. What did you change, and what happened to the numbers?”***

Applications are reviewed directly by our CEO and executive leadership. Finalists will present a proposed first-90-day plan for TekConcierge. No recruiters or agencies, please.

protected_roles.title: Plant/Manufacturing Director
protected_roles.description:
Job Summary 
Maker’s Pride is seeking a proven, enterprise-minded Plant Director to lead our largest manufacturing facility in McComb, Ohio, a site of more than 1,600 Team Members that is critical to the success of our business. The Plant Director holds full accountability for the safety, quality, service, cost, and people performance of a large-scale co-manufacturing operation, and serves as the senior leader on site and the face of the plant to customers, Team Members, and the community. 
This role requires a seasoned operations executive who has led large, complex plants of 1,000+ Team Members, can build and develop a strong leadership bench, and can balance day-to-day execution with long-term strategy. The Plant Director partners closely with senior leadership and corporate functions to deliver the plant’s operating plan, drive operational excellence, and position McComb for sustained growth.

Key Responsibilities

* Operational Leadership: Lead all plant operations, including production, packaging, maintenance, engineering, quality, warehouse, and supply chain, to consistently deliver safety, quality, service, and cost targets across multiple shifts and lines.
* P&L and Financial Accountability: Own the plant’s operating plan, budget, and financial performance, including labor, overtime, yield, waste, and capital spend. Identify and execute cost-reduction and margin-improvement opportunities.
* Strategic Planning: Develop and execute a multi-year plant strategy aligned to enterprise goals, covering capacity, capital investment, automation, new business onboarding, and talent.
* Production Planning and Capacity: Partner with Supply Chain, Planning, and Customer teams to build production schedules and resource plans that optimize throughput, labor utilization, and on-time, in-full performance.
* Quality and Food Safety: Ensure strict adherence to quality, food safety, and regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, GMP, HACCP, and customer and third-party audit standards). Drive corrective and preventive actions and maintain audit readiness at all times.
* Safety Culture: Champion a zero-harm culture. Enforce safety policies, lead regular audits and incident reviews, and hold the leadership team accountable for proactive hazard prevention and compliance.
* Workforce Strategy and Labor Relations: Partner with HR to attract, retain, and engage a large and diverse workforce. Drive staffing stability, reduce turnover, manage overtime effectively, and foster positive Team Member and labor relations, including compliance with applicable employment and labor laws and agreements.
* Customer and Partner Relationships: Serve as the senior site representative with co-manufacturing customers, hosting visits and audits, resolving escalations, and building long-term trust. Collaborate with suppliers to ensure timely delivery of materials and finished goods.
* Continuous Improvement: Lead a data-driven operational excellence program using Lean, Six Sigma, or similar methodologies to eliminate waste, improve OEE and yield, and standardize best practices across shifts.
* Capital and Asset Management: Oversee capital planning, project execution, and asset reliability to ensure equipment, infrastructure, and facilities support safe, efficient, and scalable operations.
* Reporting and Executive Communication: Provide regular, transparent reporting on safety, quality, production, financial, and workforce KPIs to senior leadership, with clear analysis, risks, and recommendations.
* Community and Site Presence: Represent Maker’s Pride in the McComb community and maintain a visible, accessible leadership presence on the plant floor across all shifts.

Supervisory Responsibilities

* Leadership of a Large Organization: Provide direct leadership to the plant leadership team and overall leadership of 1,600+ Team Members, including managers, supervisors, technicians, and support staff.
* Talent Development: Build a strong leadership bench through coaching, performance management, succession planning, and development of high-potential leaders.
* Culture and Accountability: Foster a culture of safety, quality, teamwork, accountability, respect, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field required; Master’s degree or MBA preferred.
* Experience: 15+ years of progressive manufacturing operations experience, including 7+ years in a senior plant leadership role (Plant Manager, Plant Director, or equivalent).
* Scale: Demonstrated success leading large, complex, multi-shift plants of 1,000+ Team Members, with full P&L accountability.
* Industry: Experience in co-manufacturing, food, beverage, or other high-volume, regulated manufacturing environments strongly preferred.
* Operational Excellence: Track record of delivering measurable improvements in safety, quality, productivity, and cost. Lean, Six Sigma, or similar certification desirable.
* Workforce Leadership: Proven ability to lead, motivate, and develop a large, diverse workforce, including strong experience with staffing, retention, and employee and labor relations. Experience in a unionized environment is a plus.
* Regulatory Knowledge: Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, food safety and quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Technology: Proficiency in ERP systems and Microsoft Office Suite; experience with manufacturing software (e.g., SAP, Oracle) is a plus.
* Leadership Skills: Strategic thinker with excellent executive presence, communication, and decision-making skills; able to influence at all levels of the organization and with customers.
* Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a focus on data-driven decision-making.

The information provided in this document provides an overview of the most common duties, qualifications, and demands of the position. It is not intended to be a comprehensive summary of the role, and the duties, qualifications, and demands of the position are subject to change without notice. The expectations provided here may also be modified if an employee with a disability could effectively meet the expectations for the role with reasonable accommodation.

protected_roles.description:
Gotion Inc. is based in Silicon Valley, CA, currently building a Manufacturing facility in Manteno, IL and has R&D centers in Ohio, China, Japan and Europe. We innovate in the next generation electric vehicle and energy storage technologies (lithium batteries and related systems) with the aim to accelerate electrified transportation and achieve sustainable development. Gotion is powered by a leading power battery technology company that provides solutions for vehicles including the world's first mass commercial e-bus route. 
 
Gotion is a career destination - we are not simply attempting to just fill another job, but to pursue a dream of global green energy together! We offer outstanding opportunities to individuals seeking an exciting and challenging working environment. Everyone is highly valued and plays a vital role in the growth of our organization.

**Position Summary**

The Operations Director is responsible for leading and coordinating key operational functions of the manufacturing facility, including **Production Planning, Supply Chain, Environmental Health & Safety (EHS), and Infrastructure/Construction Engineering**.

This position plays a critical role in ensuring production readiness, material availability, operational continuity, regulatory compliance, facility development, and cross-functional execution.

The Operations Director will work closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, Finance, Human Resources, and other functional leaders to support safe, efficient, and scalable operations of the Chicago manufacturing facility.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Production Planning & Operations Coordination**

* Lead production planning and scheduling based on demand, capacity, materials, and priorities.
* Develop and manage short- and long-term production plans.
* Coordinate manpower, equipment, and materials to achieve production targets.
* Monitor plan execution and identify delivery risks.
* Drive cross-functional efforts to resolve production and operational constraints.
* Track key KPIs, including production attainment, inventory, material availability, delivery, and efficiency.
* Support S&OP and capacity planning processes.

* **Supply Chain Management**

* Lead plant supply chain operations, including production planning, materials, procurement, inventory, warehousing, and logistics.
* Ensure material availability while maintaining optimal inventory levels.
* Improve inventory turnover and reduce excess and obsolete stock.
* Drive supplier performance and supply continuity.
* Identify supply chain risks and implement contingency plans.
* Manage domestic and international logistics activities.
* Lead continuous improvement in cost, efficiency, and delivery performance.

* **Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS)**

* Lead the plant's EHS programs and team to ensure compliance with safety and environmental regulations.
* Promote a strong safety culture and drive workplace safety initiatives.
* Oversee inspections, risk assessments, corrective actions, and emergency preparedness.
* Monitor EHS performance and implement corrective actions as needed.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to improve safety and compliance.
* Support regulatory audits, inspections, and permitting activities.

* **Infrastructure & Construction Engineering**

* Lead facility engineering, infrastructure, and construction projects supporting plant operations.
* Oversee plant expansion, renovations, and infrastructure improvements.
* Manage contractors, vendors, and project stakeholders.
* Ensure projects meet scope, budget, schedule, quality, and safety requirements.
* Maintain critical facility systems, utilities, and infrastructure readiness.
* Support production line installation, commissioning, and facility startup activities.

* **Operational Excellence & Cross-Functional Management**

* Establish and manage operational processes across planning, supply chain, EHS, and infrastructure.
* Lead operational reviews and drive action item completion.
* Identify and escalate operational risks to plant leadership.
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, cost, delivery, inventory, and efficiency.
* Drive KPI-based decision-making and operational visibility.
* Support ERP/MRP and digitalization initiatives.
* Foster collaboration across Operations, Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, Finance, HR, and IT.

* **Team Leadership**

* Lead, develop, and mentor managers and operational teams.
* Establish organizational structure, goals, and succession plans.
* Recruit, develop, and retain key talent.
* Drive performance, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Foster a collaborative, safety-focused, high-performance culture.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field required.
* Master's degree or MBA preferred.
* **10+ years of progressive experience** in manufacturing operations, supply chain, production planning, engineering, or related functions.
* **5+ years of leadership experience** managing managers and/or multiple operational functions.
* Strong experience in large-scale manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated experience in production planning, supply chain management, and plant operations.
* Working knowledge of EHS management and U.S. regulatory requirements.
* Experience supporting facility construction, plant expansion, infrastructure, or manufacturing engineering projects strongly preferred.
* Strong knowledge of ERP/MRP systems; SAP experience preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in **lithium-ion battery, EV, automotive, energy storage, electronics, or advanced manufacturing**.
* Experience supporting the launch or ramp-up of a new manufacturing facility in the United States.
* Experience managing complex global supply chains.
* Familiarity with high-volume automated manufacturing environments.
* Experience working with international and cross-cultural teams.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, S&OP, inventory optimization, and operational excellence methodologies.
* PMP, APICS/CPIM/CSCP, Six Sigma, or related professional certification is a plus.

**Key Performance Indicators**

Key performance measures may include:

**Production Planning:** Production Plan Attainment | Capacity Utilization | Schedule Adherence

**Supply Chain:** On-Time Delivery | Material Availability | Inventory Turns | Inventory Accuracy | Logistics Cost

**EHS:** Safety Incident Rate | Corrective Action Closure | Regulatory Compliance | Environmental Performance

**Infrastructure:** Project Schedule | Project Budget | Construction Safety | Facility Readiness | Utility Reliability

**Overall Operations:** Cost Reduction | Operational Efficiency | Risk Management | Cross-Functional Execution

**Leadership Scope**

The Operations Director provides leadership and management oversight for:

**Production Planning / PMC**

**Supply Chain & Logistics**

**Warehouse & Inventory**

**Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS)**

**Infrastructure / Construction / Facility Engineering**

protected_roles.description:
**POSITION:** Director of Planning and Production Coordination

**SHIFT:** Monday - Friday, 8:00 am - 5:00 pm + Additional hours based on business demand

**SALARY:** $139,362 - $155,161.50 + (DOE) + Full Benefits Package

**LOCATION: On-site in office in Fargo, ND**

### **SUMMARY OF RESPONSIBILITIES**

The Director of Planning and Production Coordination leads enterprise planning and production coordination across CSP, Tank and Structural product lines. The role establishes consistent planning standards, aligns demand with capacity, ensures production readiness, balances workloads across sites and supports reliable customer commitments. The role owns the planning system and coordination processes.

### **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS**

* Embrace and demonstrate the qualities of the TrueNorth Steel Game Changer definition.
* Comply with all safety, quality, environmental and workplace requirements.
* Lead, coach, and develop the CSP, Tank and Structural Planning Leaders and the Production Coordinator Supervisor, establishing clear expectations, accountability, and succession coverage.
* Establish and continuously improve an integrated planning and production-coordination system with common standards, planning horizons, terminology, decision rights, data requirements, and escalation paths.
* Align customer demand, forecasts, backlog, inventory, labor, equipment, material availability, and site capability into executable production plans.
* Confirm customer commit-date feasibility using verified readiness, material, capacity, outside-processing, site, and delivery information.
* Provide an enterprise view of capacity and constraints, leading approved workload-balancing actions such as site transfers, priority changes, outsourcing, overtime, and staffing adjustments.
* Define and enforce production-readiness requirements for drawings, bills of material, routing, material, CNC and nesting information, quality requirements, outside services, job packets, shipping information, and approvals.
* Lead regular site, product-line, and enterprise planning reviews that surface demand, capacity, backlog, readiness, schedule performance, risks, and decisions requiring action.
* Partner with Manufacturing, Sales, Project Management, Estimating, Drafting, Engineering, Purchasing, Inventory Control, Quality, Shipping, Logistics, Finance, and other functions to resolve planning constraints.
* Govern planning and production coordination data and transactions in SyteLine, Tekla and other approved systems, including capacity assumptions, work-center data, production status, and readiness information.
* Define performance measures and dashboards for schedule, backlog, capacity, readiness, equipment use, changes, and failure-related costs. Use data to improve delivery, throughput, material utilization, and profitability.
* Establish repeatable standard work, documentation, training, cross-training, and backup coverage to reduce dependence on individual knowledge.
* Serve as the escalation point for significant cross-site, cross-product, and cross-functional planning issues. Elevate unresolved matters with facts, alternatives, risks, and recommendations.
* Support annual business, capacity, capital, workforce, and budget planning, along with strategic manufacturing initiatives.
* Provide the VP of Manufacturing with regular updates on planning risks, delivery, capacity, material, organizational needs, trends, and recommended actions.
* Travel to manufacturing sites is required to understand processes, build relationships, support teams, and ensure consistent implementation of planning and production-coordination standards.
* Prompt and dependable attendance.
* Other duties as assigned.

### **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND QUALITIES**

* Strong knowledge of manufacturing planning, scheduling, capacity management, production coordination, inventory, and shop-floor execution.
* Ability to lead leaders and standardize planning processes across multiple manufacturing sites or business units.
* Working knowledge of ERP-supported planning, bills of material, routing, work centers, job release, inventory, and production transactions.
* Strong analytical judgment and ability to balance customer commitments, manufacturing capability, cost, and business risk.
* Effective communication, facilitation, change leadership and cross-functional influence skills.
* High integrity, accountability, attention to detail, sound judgment, and bias toward action.
* Commitment to safety, quality, customer service, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

### **EDUCATION AND WORK EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor’s degree in Operations Management, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, Business Administration, Construction Management or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
* Minimum of ten years of progressive responsible experience in manufacturing operations, planning, scheduling, supply chain, project coordination, or a related field preferred, including five years of leadership experience.
* Experience leading multi-site planning or operational processes, ERP-supported planning and cross-functional improvement preferred.
* Experience in steel fabrication, metal manufacturing, project-based manufacturing, or a related industrial environment preferred.

This is a key leadership role responsible for the full management of plant functions, regulatory compliance, and a small team of operators.

Position Overview

The Plant Manager oversees all day-to-day and long-term operations of NGU’s Level 3 water treatment plant. The position ensures continuous production of safe, high-quality water that meets or exceeds all Tennessee Department of Environment and Conservation (TDEC) and U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) standards and guidance. protected_roles.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Engineering
protected_roles.description:
Atomic Machines is building the Matter Compiler™, the first in a new class of AI-native, all-digital manufacturing systems that build working machines directly from code. The Matter Compiler (MC) is aimed at micro-machines: motors and gears the size of a grain of sand, robots small enough to work inside the body, cooling built directly into the chips that run AI, and the many devices like them that have been waiting on a way to build them. Its first product is PrimeSwitch™, an electromechanical power relay the size of a button battery that carries 150 amps continuous current and opens in 50 microseconds, about a thousand times faster than a conventional contactor. Founded by Jeff Holden — serial entrepreneur, ex-Amazon SVP and Uber's first Chief Product Officer — the company has raised $250 million to date.

Atomic Machines is based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with offices in Emeryville and Santa Clara.

### **About The Role:**

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Platform Manufacturing Engineering to lead Production Manufacturing Engineering as we scale the Matter Compiler from pilot production into high-volume manufacturing. You will own the equipment that builds our devices — its build, integration, bring-up, qualification and reliability — and the team of engineers who deliver it.

**You are an engineer first.** This is a player-coach role and the player half is not decorative: you will spearhead the hardest projects on the critical path personally, in CAD and on the floor, and use that work as the vehicle for coaching everyone around you. The fastest way to set a standard here is to define it while you produce work that meets it, then mentor your team to achieve the same bar.

Mentoring here happens inside the work, not alongside it. You will pull engineers onto the projects you lead, hand off scope as they are ready for it, review their designs with real technical depth, and grow the next set of project leads out of people who learned by building with you.

The management half is real. You will hire against a plan rather than a wish list, develop engineers toward the next level, run performance honestly, and install the operating standards this function works to — documentation, change control, qualification and release discipline, and what "done" means before work leaves the group. You will plan the organization ahead of where the business is today, own headcount and capital budget, and get manufacturability and equipment requirements into specifications set by other teams rather than reviewing them at the end.

### **What You'll Do:**

* Spearhead the hardest equipment projects on the critical path yourself — architecture, CAD, build, bring-up and qualification — and bring engineers along on them as the primary way they develop.
* Lead a team of 5–10 engineers spanning equipment design, automation and controls, integration, and sustaining, through a mix of direct reports and technical leads.
* Set the engineering standard by producing work to it: reference designs, qualification plans, RCCAs and documentation your team can pattern from, with the reasoning made explicit so it transfers.
* Coach through the work — pair on designs, run technical reviews with real depth, hand off scope as engineers are ready for it, and grow the next set of project leads out of people who built alongside you.
* Own the delivery record for the function — the equipment, qualifications and production readiness your team commits to, against committed dates.
* Lead equipment deployment end to end: installation, validation, commissioning, acceptance testing, SOP/WI release and operator qualification.
* Run root cause and corrective action personally on the failures that matter, teach the method by doing it in front of the team, and drive the corrective actions across teams that do not report to you.
* Install and uphold the operating standards: documentation, change control, qualification and release discipline, RCCA method and closure, and how work is reviewed before it leaves the group.
* Plan organizational growth — forecast hiring needs ahead of demand, define roles and levels, build and defend the hiring plan, and manage headcount and capital budget with Supply Chain and Finance.
* Own and resolve escalated personnel situations arising from business and priority changes, rather than routing them away.
* Get manufacturability and equipment requirements into specification setting and design milestones with Design Engineering and Product, rather than reviewing at the end.
* Balance competing priorities with peer leaders so committed deliverables are still met, and own communication of impact and resolution path where they cannot be.
* Own contract manufacturer and automation supplier execution through final integration and test to conformant hardware on schedule.
* Drive throughput, yield, cost and uptime improvement — held with control limits, not delivered as one-time gains — and establish the operating metrics and reporting cadence leadership can rely on without chasing.
* Travel between Emeryville and Santa Clara sites as needed.

### **What You'll Need:**

* 7+ years of manufacturing or equipment engineering experience, including 3+ years managing engineers with 5 or more direct reports.
* **Current hands-on capability.** You still design in CAD, still debug hardware on the floor, and could take the hardest open task on your team's board tomorrow. We will test this directly in the loop.
* Proven ownership of automated production equipment end to end — architecture through mechanical, controls and software integration, into a qualified, released system running in production.
* Proficiency in CAD for equipment design (SolidWorks, Onshape, AutoCAD or similar), with recent personal use.
* A track record of **developing engineers through the work** — specific people who grew because you put them on projects you were leading, reviewed their designs, and handed off scope as they were ready for it.
* A track record of building out a functional group: defining roles, hiring against a plan, and installing the operating standards — not only inheriting an existing team.
* Experience leading a team spanning more than one discipline (e.g., equipment, controls/automation, integration, sustaining), including people whose work sits outside your own background.
* Ownership of headcount and capital budget, with resourcing tradeoff decisions made under real constraint.
* Depth across DFx, RCCA, eBOMmBOM conversion, qualification and acceptance testing, and PLM/document control and release (Arena a plus).
* Experience in semiconductor, solar, hardware-based biotech, EV, or similar high-tech industries.
* Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functionally without authority — specifically, getting manufacturing and equipment requirements into specifications owned by other teams.
* A first-principles mindset — you question assumptions, reframe problems from the ground up, and approach challenges with a foundational understanding rather than relying solely on precedent.
* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

### **Bonus Points For:**

* Experience standing up or rebuilding a manufacturing or equipment engineering function at a company moving from pilot to production scale.
* Experience staying technically current while managing — a design, patent, or build you personally delivered while running a team.
* Knowledge of basic coding: RSLogix, Ignition, Python, or C/C++.

Atomic Machines is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and does not discriminate based on characteristics protected by applicable law. We are committed to an inclusive interview experience, including for individuals with disabilities. To request an accommodation, contact rc@atomicmachines.com. To help our recruiting team manage application volume and respond to candidates more efficiently, Atomic Machines may use AI-assisted tools.

protected_roles.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

The Senior Manufacturing Engineering Manager is responsible for overseeing and leading a team of engineers to deliver technical projects efficiently and effectively. This role involves managing resources, budgets, and project timelines, ensuring high-quality engineering solutions, and providing technical guidance. The Senior Manufacturing Engineering Manager is responsible for team development, stakeholder communication and implementing best practices to achieve project goals and drive innovation. 
#LI-BB2

**A Day In The Life**
---------------------

Every day at Hubbell is different and you’ll contribute in many ways. On any given day, you’ll make a difference by:

Serving in a leadership role, directly supervising project engineers and designers.

Overseeing, managing, and supporting calibration programs for the facilities, including production equipment, facility equipment.

Developing concepts for new and revised products maximizing function, safety, features, and user benefits while minimizing costs.

Directing preparation of models and lab testing as required to develop product.

Preparing and maintaining Project Control Charts and schedules.

Participating in meetings as required to communicate and coordinate projects with various departments within Hubbell.

Developing the site maintenance budget for approval and managing site budget costs to meet the approved budget targets.

Directing preparation of product drawings and checking completed drawings.

Preparing product standards and specifications and obtaining agency listings as required (UL/CSA etc.).

Approving tooling, assemblies, and updating drawings. Release approved product for production.

**What will help you thrive in this role?**
-------------------------------------------

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (required)

10+ years of relevant experience (required)

5+ supervisory experience in an engineering related field (required)

Ability to check design drawings with extreme thoroughness while paying strict attention to detail

Ability to manage multiple design projects with varying priority levels

Proven track record working with systems engineering functions including concept of operations development, requirements management, technical risk management, interface definition and control

Experience effectively communicating and presenting with all levels of management and individual contributors on the program team

Strong organization, coordination, planning and collaboration skills

Experience supporting engineering teams in a multi-discipline environment

Experience conducting system integration and system tests to include development of integration and test plans, test cases and procedures

Ability to visualize system functionality, to create block diagrams, and to analyze system performance

**Hubbell Incorporated**

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

**Hubbell Utility Solutions**

Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible.

Hubbell Incorporated, its subsidiaries and affiliates, is an EO Employer AA: M/F/Veteran/Disability. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other protected class.

The above summary of position responsibilities and requirements is not intended, and should not be construed, to be an exhaustive list of duties, skills, efforts, physical requirements, or working conditions associated with the position. It is intended to be an accurate reflection of those principal position elements essential for making decisions related to position performance, employee development, and compensation.

**Job Description:**

**Job Title:**

**Senior Plant Manager** (Corona, CA)

**Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World**

Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with 96,000 other curious, creative 3Mers.

**This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military environments to a 3M career.**

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role** 
As the **Senior Plant Manager,** you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

 

* Active and visible EHS ownership to ensure site compliance, stewardship and championing continuous improvement efforts to improve all aspects of EHS.
* Accountable for strategic planning and budgeting to drive sustainable improvements in factory cost through application of Lean Six Sigma, entitlement thinking, yield improvement, plant productivity and capital planning.
* Implement lean manufacturing principles and methodology to drive employee engagement and continuous improvement, with a strong focus on TPM, 5S and Standard work.
* Managing supply chain execution and inventory management to ensure appropriate supply chain performance through responsiveness, delivery performance, capacity management, supplier management, and appropriate inventory management.
* Represent 3M and engage with key accounts.
* Engaging the community by representing 3M in community affairs as appropriate and foster good public relations in the local community.

**Your Skills and Expertise**

To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

 

* Bachelor's degree or higher (completed and verified prior to start)
* Three (3) years of supervisory and/or management experience in a private, public, government or military environment
* Five (5) years of manufacturing experience in a private, public, government or military environment

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

 

* Certified LSS BB or MBB
* Experience in Operations Management
* Union experience a plus
* Expert knowledge and experience in production management, lean manufacturing and materials control
* Strong Communication and Change Management skills
* Experience in Lean manufacturing methodologies in driving value stream improvement.
* Prior Plant Manager Experience

**Location:** Onsite Corona, CA

**Travel:** May include up to 10% domestic/international

**Relocation Assistance:** May be authorized

**Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).**

**Supporting Your Well-being**

3M offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, 3M regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

**SENIOR MANAGER, QUALITY IMPROVEMENT**

**What you’ll do.**

As the Senior Manager, Quality Improvement, you’ll help neurologists put evidence into practice by managing the processes that support clinical practice guidelines, evidence-based publications, and resources. You’ll advance the AAN’s strategic objectives by supporting the development of timely, evidence-based clinical guidelines, editorial and dissemination strategies, and meaningful resources that engage neurologists in improving their practice. Working across divisions, you’ll connect clinical practice and quality efforts to deliver value for AAN members.

**Please review the attached job description for full details. If viewing from an external site, please visit** **https://www.aan.com/about-the-aan/work-at-the-aan****.**

**Who we are.**

Join a diverse community of fun, energetic, and dedicated employees and members who are committed to supporting neurologists worldwide in providing exceptional care to their patients. The AAN's vision is to be indispensable to our members, and we continue to embrace our values of Community, Leadership, Well-being and Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion. Together, we pursue our mission to enhance member career fulfillment and promote brain health for all.

The AAN, founded in Minneapolis in 1948, supports and represents more than 44,000 neurologists and neuroscience professionals worldwide who provide crucial patient care, seek new cures and treatments for brain disease and work to ensure patient access to the right care. Our headquarters is in a stunning, energy-efficient office, located in downtown Minneapolis’s dynamic Mill District, and our public policy office is near the action on Capitol Hill in Washington, DC. Both locations offer easy access to light rail, major bus lines, parking options, walking/biking paths, and a myriad of dining and entertainment choices, making it a vibrant hub for everyone.

**What we look for.**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Public Health, Health Care Management, Health Sciences, Nursing, or related field

**Experience:**

* Minimum of 5 years of related experience in healthcare management and quality improvement
* Minimum of 3 years of supervisory experience
* Minimum of 3 years of project management experience
* Demonstrated ability to uphold the AAN’s values
* Demonstrated ability to supervise a team in a fast-paced environment and nurture individual career development and growth
* Ability to provide clear instructions and successful presentations to staff, work groups and panels
* Demonstrated skill, tact, diplomacy, confidentiality, and professionalism in interactions with teams, members, and other relevant individuals or groups
* Demonstrated proficiency using MS Office for word, spreadsheet, and presentations
* Excellent time management skills, ability to deliver results when facing multiple projects with tight deadlines
* Advanced knowledge of evidence-based medicine and clinical practice guideline development is preferred
* Knowledge of established evidence grading, and recommendation-development methods, such as GRADE or comparable frameworks is preferred
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and physician or subject-matter expert panels through complex evidence-based projects is preferred
* Demonstrated experience providing strategic and operational leadership for multiple concurrent, multi-year programs or projects is preferred
* Experience identifying and implementing process improvements, technology, or emerging approaches is preferred

*Relevant education and/or experience exceeding the required qualifications may be substituted on a year-for-year basis.*

**Travel Requirements:** Minimal travel required – up to 5%

**Location:** Minneapolis, MN and is identified as hybrid (required to work in the office with the ability to work remotely part of the week)

**Schedule:** Occasional evening and weekends required

**What we offer.**

Our excellent benefits package that works as hard for you as you do for us.

* **Thrive at Work and Beyond**
 + Flexible work arrangements
 + Generous PTO & holidays
 + Comprehensive wellness programs
 + Paid parental, family, and bereavement leave
* **Benefits to Secure Your Future**
 + Competitive salary & incentive program
 + 10.5% 401(k) contribution & financial planning resources
 + Paid life, and both long- and short-term disability insurance
* **Benefits to Grow With Us**
 + Tuition reimbursement
 + Professional development opportunities
 + Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion training programs
 + Monetary years of service recognition awards
* **Feel Recognized & Connected (Culture & Community)**
 + Employee awards & peer recognition to celebrate excellence
 + Team-building events & company celebrations to foster connections
 + Diversity, Equity & Inclusion initiatives to create a culture where everyone belongs
 + Volunteer days & charitable giving programs to make an impact beyond the workplace
* **Health & Happiness (Medical, Dental, Vision & More)**
 + Comprehensive health coverage with medical, dental, and vision plans
 + Telemedicine & mental health resources for accessible care
 + Onsite workout facility, gender-neutral restroom, wellness and lactation rooms
 + Transportation subsidy
 + Flavored waters & on-site fitness

**Great Location:** Our headquarters is a beautiful, energy-efficient office in Minneapolis, MN. Our headquarters is in a stunning, energy-efficient office, located in downtown Minneapolis’s dynamic Mill District, and our public policy office is near the action on Capitol Hill in Washington, DC. Both locations offer easy access to light rail, major bus lines, parking options, walking/biking paths, and a myriad of dining and entertainment choices, making it a vibrant hub for everyone.

**Great People in Great Careers:** The AAN offers talent opportunities in the fields of Administration, Accounting, Marketing, Communications, Digital Development, Event Planning, Social Media, Research, Health Policy, Information Systems, Project Management, and more.

View our press room, conferences, world-renowned guidelines, social media channels, patient and caregiver magazine, and most recent Annual Report.
